note: Each requirement a test proves, registered before its test exists. A row holds its id (<owner's last segment>.<words>), one description sentence, the owner package, its layer (unit, integration, contract, e2e or native; a layer's limit is test-sizes.json's for its size) and its seconds budget; a test names the ids it proves with @pytest.mark.proves. Holders, lifecycle (proposed, active, quarantined, retired) and the commit that added a row are derived, never stored. An id is never reused: a retired row stays. Find before writing one: python scripts/tests_registry.py find "<words>".

agent_eval.native_transcript_readers_pre.description: Offline native graders retain exact transcript counts, source admission, and member-key evidence after Host usage moves to OTLP.

alpha_research.current_artifacts_read_on.lower_layer: It reads real sealed files through the owner's store and the process memory, which a unit test of one function cannot hold.

alpha_research.foundation_feature_axis_i.description: An Alpha compiler refuses a foundation feature axis that is narrowed, reordered or changed.

alpha_research.historical_sector_coverag.description: Historical Sector coverage changes an Alpha foundation's identity without changing its Sector revision or legacy identities.

alpha_research.lifecycle_arrays_full_pro.description: If full proof passed lifecycle arrays changed under their name, an install, an activation or the scrub would admit bytes never proved.
alpha_research.lifecycle_arrays_full_pro.lower_layer: It reads real sealed files through the owner's store and the process memory, which a unit test of one function cannot hold.

alpha_research.lifecycle_arrays_kept_per.description: If sealed lifecycle arrays were read and decoded again for each admission, every daily score would repeat work their sealed name already settled.
alpha_research.lifecycle_arrays_kept_per.lower_layer: It reads real sealed files through the owner's store and the process memory, which a unit test of one function cannot hold.

alpha_research.sealed_selection_survives.description: If members added later could move a sealed inner selection, an Alpha study's recorded choice would stop matching the evidence it came from.

alpha_research.sector_coverage_follows_p.description: Alpha's Sector coverage follows the selected Panel's listings and refuses incomplete coverage.
alpha_research.sector_coverage_follows_p.lower_layer: The Sector reader is composed at the Host's research-authoring boundary, which the unit layer cannot import.

alpha_research.verification_hash_covers_.description: If an executed scoring or outcome module sat outside the verified hash, changed code would keep an old identity and pass as already verified.

alternative_evidence.absent_consent_uses.description: An absent Evidence source consent reads as the default while an unreadable record does not.

alternative_evidence.availability_names_.description: A document's availability names what it rests on: the official acceptance, a recorded import's capture, or the source's statement.

alternative_evidence.evidence_reads_sett.description: The evidence reads setting reads world when unset, the workspace's own store when it says workspace, and refuses any other value by name.
alternative_evidence.evidence_reads_sett.retired: 2026-11-20: ALPHALATTICE_EVIDENCE_READS is retired; world is the evidence reader, with the workspace's store before admission

alternative_evidence.evidence_reads_thro.description: An evidence document's body is read through world at its selection's cutoff, admitted when its acquisition ends, and from the workspace under the rollback setting.
alternative_evidence.evidence_reads_thro.lower_layer: The read goes through the Host's StorePort and the as-of macro over a real DuckLake catalog and the data root's blobs.

alternative_evidence.historical_identity.description: Observed Evidence history excludes current and supported bindings while retaining each unknown tuple once.

alternative_evidence.host_stop_preserves.description: A Host stop during a coverage unit leaves no sealed unit failure and the same Task resumes after the Host restarts.

alternative_evidence.int8_generation_nam.description: If an int8 generation did not name its machine class in its identity, or another generation's hash moved, numbers from different machines could be compared by bytes.

alternative_evidence.missing_body_refuse.description: A body world holds but the disk lacks is refused by name with its restore recovery, so a missing evidence body never reads as absent without the backup it needs.

alternative_evidence.recorded_documents_.description: If recorded issuer documents in Chinese, a revision or a source's retirement were mishandled, development evidence would lose documents the full corpus keeps.
alternative_evidence.recorded_documents_.lower_layer: Canonicalization reaches the section reader's lazy module loader, which the unit layer's contract refuses, so admission is proved where it runs.

alternative_evidence.retrieval_change_ke.description: A selection made again after a retrieval change keeps the earlier result's identity when every question's passages are the same, and otherwise leaves its receipt sealed and records the change beside it, never as a successor.
alternative_evidence.retrieval_change_ke.lower_layer: The comparison reads both receipts and their sealed span sets back from a real workspace artifact store over the Host's retrieval store.

alternative_evidence.retrieval_delivers_.description: The installed retrieval packs find evidence for both development issuers and every delivered citation resolves to its declared range and source revision.
alternative_evidence.retrieval_delivers_.lower_layer: The workspace verifier, real CPU models, history, and canonical revision reader must run together.

alternative_evidence.retrieval_reads_wor.description: Retrieval keys evidence chunks by world's document and version and reads bodies from world at the cutoff, never returning superseded versions.
alternative_evidence.retrieval_reads_wor.lower_layer: World's evidence documents and the store's projections are a real DuckLake catalog and a real log, so the as-of read needs both.

alternative_evidence.review_rerun_joins_.description: A repeated book review joins the preparation in flight at any cutoff, reads no filing index beside it, and a parked one is handed back without a person.

alternative_evidence.review_stands_on_it.description: A later run of the same positions that no analysis answers does not take a book's review from the run its analyses answer, and a run that carried them keeps it.

alternative_evidence.runtime_identity_bi.description: If the Evidence runtime's identity left out an owner of selection or a capability, reviews could reuse retrieval from a different runtime.
alternative_evidence.runtime_identity_bi.retired: 2026-11-19: the hand-written retrieval core that decided selection retired; the retrieval store's runtime identity is proved by alternative_evidence.runtime_identity_refuses_a_changed_capability

alternative_evidence.runtime_identity_re.description: If a workspace installed an Evidence runtime whose semantic capability differs, its reviews would run on a model its identity never named.

alternative_evidence.runtime_refuses_wit.description: A workspace with verified evidence authority refuses when its retrieval runtime is unavailable.
alternative_evidence.runtime_refuses_wit.lower_layer: The check opens sealed workspace authority and computes the runtime capability through the product verifier.

alternative_evidence.store_hits_delivere.description: A store hit is cut to the lines its question states, one candidate a line, so over the development evidence set every issuer-topic cell the line chunks reached holds evidence and a delivered span is the matched sentence.
alternative_evidence.store_hits_delivere.lower_layer: The selection's cell allocation reads the spans a real review delivers from the Host's retrieval store over the development documents.

alternative_evidence.world_body_reads_re.description: A world evidence body is returned only when its bytes match world's digest and size, and an unknown body is refused by name.

alternative_evidence.world_holds_each_do.description: A workspace open admits each acquired evidence document into world once per machine, its body kept under blobs/ by its BLAKE3 and an amendment naming its original.
alternative_evidence.world_holds_each_do.lower_layer: The admission reads the workspace's sealed artifacts and source objects and commits through StorePort into a real DuckLake catalog.

architecture.an_unlisted_persisting_writ.description: A writer that persists bytes and no data family lists is refused by name at commit, while a read and an in-memory database are not.
architecture.an_unlisted_persisting_writ.lower_layer: The scan reads a planted module file through the cached per-file facts store, which a unit test cannot reach.

architecture.an_unresolved_change_stops_.description: A change no consumer map resolves stops the verification runner at its exit code; it never plans nothing and passes.

exception.why: The costliest tooling tests were rewritten: shared build-once Git histories, one shared child session and tool stubs replace a child process per case; no test function was added
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: the excess is shared build-once fixtures and tool stubs that remove child processes; every case kept

architecture.discovered_imports_kept_by_.description: A module's discovered imports are kept in the process by its place under the source root and its bytes, so changed bytes or another place miss and a read or parse error is raised every time.

architecture.every_persisted_family_is_l.description: Every writer the product persists through is listed by a data family, and every storage and artifact authority group is covered by exactly one.
architecture.every_persisted_family_is_l.lower_layer: It reads the whole source tree and three registries from disk.

architecture.every_src_module_imports_of.description: Every src module imports with the network disabled, and each pydantic contract's frozen and extra settings at runtime match those read from source by the static contract test.

architecture.impact_graph_selection.description: The verification selector finds real consumer and deleted-source tests and dispatches them without repeating structural checks.

architecture.import_law_refuses_higher_l.description: The import law built from the package registry refuses a package importing a higher level or an undeclared peer, and any file importing a retired owner, direct or relative; an import downward or of a lookalike name passes.

architecture.kernel_ports_enforce_import.description: Kernel packages import downward through ports, with only standard-library dependencies and no access to another owner's internals or reserved APIs.
architecture.kernel_ports_enforce_import.lower_layer: Only the real Import Linter graph can resolve relative ports and external packages and prove that the generated contracts refuse them.

architecture.repository_root_is_its_trac.description: The repository root is judged by the files git tracks at HEAD: its required public files, nothing unexpected, and never a checkout's ignored or untracked local files.

architecture.scan_facts_kept_by_bytes_un.description: A scan's kept per-file fact is served only for the bytes it came from under a valid seal and shape, and its store stays bounded and rebuildable.

architecture.type_ignores_only_fall.description: A commit is refused when a file's type: ignore count for an error code rises, a new file holds one, one names no code, or the baseline rose; one command lowers it.
architecture.type_ignores_only_fall.lower_layer: The refusal reads staged blobs, a staged move and the parent's baseline through Git, which a unit test cannot hold.

architecture.wait_baseline_only_falls.description: A commit is refused when a staged source holds more wait findings than the baseline, or when the baseline rose above its parent.
architecture.wait_baseline_only_falls.lower_layer: The refusal reads staged blobs and the parent's baseline through Git, which a unit test cannot hold.

architecture.wait_rules_refuse_each_anti.description: Each wait rule refuses its unbounded wait or loop by name with its repair, and passes that repair and the wait primitive itself.

causal_outcomes.carried_chunk_is_proved_.description: A carried execution-outcome chunk is admitted only when each row's hash is over its values and the chunk's identity over its rows.

composition.a_book_is_sealed_at_the_prod.description: The product's own recipe seals the sufficient set's strategy book on Alpha's 1,260-session window, over at least 100 listings, with calibration's 80-member rule and a top-k inside its range.
composition.a_book_is_sealed_at_the_prod.lower_layer: Only the whole road of Data, Alpha, Risk, strategy preparation and the book shows the floors the product's recipe actually reached together.

composition.a_network_stopped_update_res.description: An activated book's update stopped on the network resumes by the way its stop names, whichever switch holds it.

composition.authored_declarations_cannot.description: An authored identity or a foreign schema name is refused before planning decides an identity.
composition.authored_declarations_cannot.lower_layer: The tests exercise the experiment composition validator directly.

composition.bad_experiment_requests_do_n.description: Malformed or inadmissible experiment requests do not admit Tasks or displace Portfolio controls.
composition.bad_experiment_requests_do_n.lower_layer: The refusal, Task registry and Portfolio controls are read together through the running Host.

composition.book_controls_round_trip_the.description: The installed book's controls give its editable declaration, saving and loading it keeps the defaults, and the named preview accepts that flat document.
composition.book_controls_round_trip_the.lower_layer: Only a whole Host serving an activated book through its real Task, data and update stages shows this behaviour end to end.

exception.why: It copies the strategy-book road at the floors' scale, replacing a journey that copied the private QA store.
exception.decided: 2026-11-20: a journey moved from the QA-store copy to the private strategy-book road.

composition.capacity_blocked_study_resum.description: A study stopped by a storage cap resumes its same confirmed Task only after capacity and unchanged input are restored.
composition.capacity_blocked_study_resum.lower_layer: The Host composes the capacity stop, input verification, Task recovery and exact reuse.

composition.cli_and_web_compile_same_exp.description: CLI and web requests compile the same bound experiment document and Program.
composition.cli_and_web_compile_same_exp.lower_layer: The CLI and web paths must both reach the running Host and its bound input.

composition.cli_names_a_closed_output_pi.description: The command reports an output pipe that closes before its answer finishes and returns failure.

composition.daily_automation_resumes_the.description: Daily replay keeps its original persisted Task when rereading a published result or when an enabled update defers for incomplete inputs and its retry becomes due.
composition.daily_automation_resumes_the.lower_layer: It drives the live Host scheduler and consumes the Task lifecycle committed by Task Control's persisted runner.

composition.feature_extension_page_reads.description: The feature extension route reads the page number and names the first out-of-range page.
composition.feature_extension_page_reads.lower_layer: The named refusal traverses query parsing and the live feature-extension route.

composition.goal_export_proves_its_sourc.description: If a Goal export answered from kept sources, a changed sealed result could leave the workspace without a fresh proof.
composition.goal_export_proves_its_sourc.lower_layer: It composes a Goal over a real Host reading a sealed result through the reader the Goal application calls.

composition.keyed_analyst_submissions_ke.description: Concurrent keyed Analyst submissions receive definite outcomes, filed outcomes replay exactly, and refusals that filed nothing are retryable.

composition.observation_writes_do_not_wa.description: A held workspace mutation does not prevent the independent observation owner from recording request entry and a counted refusal.

composition.only_a_finished_first_use_ow.description: A network cleanup belongs only to a finished first-use Goal and follows its last delegated network choice.
composition.only_a_finished_first_use_ow.lower_layer: The Goal composition owner imports Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

composition.records_map_to_spans_and_log.description: Each record the Host keeps is written whole into its history, an operation as one started-then-ended span and every other record as a fact, and each activity read is answered from it.
composition.records_map_to_spans_and_log.lower_layer: The mapping runs in a live Host's composition, and only its history's SQLite file shows what a reader reads.

composition.replay_refuses_a_tampered_in.description: If a replay ran from a tampered input bundle, it would claim to reproduce a result from bytes that were never bound.
composition.replay_refuses_a_tampered_in.lower_layer: It tampers a bound input copy and replays through a real Host and its worker.

composition.scrub_finds_a_changed_study_.description: If a sealed file changed under its name went unnoticed, an export would leave with changed bytes; the scrub must find it and the study must refuse until its bytes check again.
composition.scrub_finds_a_changed_study_.lower_layer: It plants a change in a published study's evidence and drives reads, an export and the scrub through a real Host.

composition.sealed_review_update_verifie.description: Concurrent readers of one sealed review update share one verification, each with its own copy, and a failed verification is never kept.

composition.session_observation_attribut.description: A named sandbox-bound Session keeps its request attribution while an anonymous request remains unassigned and Activity names that attribution unknown.

composition.unstarted_evidence_task_repo.description: An Evidence Task without a run reports the cutoff from its sealed request.
composition.unstarted_evidence_task_repo.lower_layer: The Evidence composition owner imports Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

composition.workspace_binding_usage_unkn.description: An unreadable workspace-owned Session binding makes usage unavailable without hiding other readable Session results or treating the binding as absent.

config.environment_access_uses_the_confi.description: The config port serves one environment snapshot, declares settings changes and keeps secrets out of diagnostics.

data_layer.a_backup_copy_excludes_collec.description: A collection waits while a backup copies the data root and decides no body until the copy ends.
data_layer.a_backup_copy_excludes_collec.lower_layer: The lock is the one backup_data_root holds; the log is a fake that keeps what the collector does.

data_layer.a_body_goes_only_when_nothing.description: The collector removes an artifact body only when no live reference, pin or retention window holds it, recording its collection before the body goes.
data_layer.a_body_goes_only_when_nothing.lower_layer: Holds are live_ref rows the projection writes from real events in a SQLite log; the body is a file in a real data root.

data_layer.a_brief_budget_is_bounded.description: If a brief took any budget, an agent could ask for none of the brief, or for more than its context holds.

data_layer.a_brief_fits_its_budget_in_pr.description: If a brief broke its budget, or let lessons or similar experiences take the room of the goal's current decisions, or read anything recorded after its cut, the agent would start new work on the wrong or later knowledge.
data_layer.a_brief_fits_its_budget_in_pr.lower_layer: The brief joins the log's events, notes and class members in DuckDB over a real log.

data_layer.a_cache_is_valid_for_exactly_.description: A cached partition's input digest moves with exactly the admissions, lag rules and cutoff its parts see, and with nothing else.

data_layer.a_class_read_gives_its_effect.description: If a class read gave no effective N, or counted series known only after its cut, a result's significance would be read against the raw trial count, or against later knowledge.
data_layer.a_class_read_gives_its_effect.lower_layer: The series are inline bodies in the log read by DuckDB's SQLite scan, so only a real log shows them correlated.

data_layer.a_class_read_is_a_search_memo.description: If a class read left no search_memory step in the Host's log, which experience reads informed a trial could never be measured; if it carried the query or the records, it would hold what the conventions keep opt-in.
data_layer.a_class_read_is_a_search_memo.lower_layer: The step is the span the Host's log accepts by its registered event type, so only a real log shows it recorded.

data_layer.a_class_read_is_cut_at_its_kn.description: If a class read named the wrong trials at a width, or counted a trial, a state or a measure learned after its cutoff, an agent would judge a result against a spread that never existed then.
data_layer.a_class_read_is_cut_at_its_kn.lower_layer: The read joins the log's trials, recipes, events and measures through the reading views in DuckDB; only a real log shows each width and cut.

data_layer.a_class_read_splits_its_effec.description: If a class read gave no effect by market condition, or banded a member by a condition recorded after its cut, which approach works in which market could not be read, or would be read from later knowledge.
data_layer.a_class_read_splits_its_effec.lower_layer: The bands join the log's condition artifacts and measures to the class in DuckDB over a real log.

data_layer.a_class_width_is_named.description: If an unknown class width were read as some default, an agent would get a class it did not ask for.

data_layer.a_clients_trace_reaches_its_w.description: Client trace context reaches its Host and worker spans; the log and an opted-in receiver retain their trace, and external secrets and content are protected.
data_layer.a_clients_trace_reaches_its_w.lower_layer: A real Host serves the request over loopback HTTP and a real worker process runs the call; the spans are read from a real log and an in-memory OTLP/HTTP receiver.

data_layer.a_condition_digest_names_its_.description: If a condition artifact's content digest left out its values, two different results of one question would claim one content, and the digest could not tell them apart.

data_layer.a_correction_is_known_from_it.description: StorePort admits one fact as one version however a writer stages it, a changed value as a new version known from its admission, and supersedes each held version once.
data_layer.a_correction_is_known_from_it.lower_layer: The versions are written to and read as of from a real DuckLake catalog through the views.

data_layer.a_document_is_keyed_by_its_do.description: A legacy evidence document batch names no market and is keyed by its doc_id, so two bodies of one document go in separate admissions.

data_layer.a_lake_scan_holds_files_by_th.description: A DuckDB session over the lake scans a table of many small Parquet files holding open about one file per thread, never one per file, so a process stays within macOS's default 256 descriptors however many files admissions leave.
data_layer.a_lake_scan_holds_files_by_th.lower_layer: Descriptors are held by DuckDB's reader over real Parquet files; only a real catalog and its files show them.

data_layer.a_lake_session_bounds_its_rea.description: Every DuckDB session over the lake loads its extensions and then turns DuckDB's read-ahead off, so no scan holds a queue of open Parquet files.

data_layer.a_legacy_document_is_known_fr.description: A legacy evidence document is known from its 0.2.7 availability, the source's acceptance or a recorded import's capture, never its filing date; another body of a held document is known no earlier than its admission.
data_layer.a_legacy_document_is_known_fr.lower_layer: The known time is derived by StorePort's catalog SQL in a real DuckLake commit and read back through the as-of macro.

data_layer.a_note_closes_what_it_reviews.description: If a review's note did not close its trial or task with its run's aggregates in one unit, a reader could see a verdict without the usage and cost it rests on.
data_layer.a_note_closes_what_it_reviews.lower_layer: It needs the real log's projection triggers and a reviewed trial's spans in one SQLite unit, which no single function holds.

data_layer.a_note_renders_the_same_bytes.description: If the same note rendered different bytes, its experience's BLAKE3 name would change and every re-render would mint a version for nothing.

data_layer.a_note_says_each_part.description: If a note could omit its hypothesis, method or conclusion or hold a blank lesson, an experience would cite a review that says nothing.

data_layer.a_number_has_one_typed_form.description: A number has one typed form, so 5 and 5.0 are one recipe parameter and one measure dimension, and a value with none is refused.

data_layer.a_reads_answer_and_refusal_cr.description: A reading view's answer reaches the Host from the reader's process as the read returned it, a mapping too; the read's own refusal arrives by its code; any other failure is refused as the history being unavailable.

data_layer.a_rename_moves_no_key.description: A renamed method, metric or feature set keeps its lineage's id, so no recipe key, measure, cache entry or derived partition moves, and every old name still finds it.
data_layer.a_rename_moves_no_key.lower_layer: A rename is an event projected inside the log's own SQLite transaction; only a real log shows the rows it leaves.

data_layer.a_return_series_is_kept_in_it.description: If a malformed series were kept, the class read's correlations would join months that are not calendar months or read values that are not returns.

data_layer.a_source_supersedes_only_with.description: StorePort writes a closed interval's two versions and supersedes a held bar only with a source write after its value's last write, which a same-value write moves without a version.
data_layer.a_source_supersedes_only_with.lower_layer: The versions are written to and read as of from a real DuckLake catalog.

data_layer.a_source_time_is_not_content.description: A row's value digest leaves out its source's write time and original payload digest, and a legacy closed interval carries the digest of its open version.
data_layer.a_source_time_is_not_content.retired: 2026-11-17: no digest remains for the source time to stay out of; a source time never decides newness, proved by data_layer.a_correction_is_known_from_its_admission's rewrite row

data_layer.a_stuck_log_reader_is_ended.description: A reading views process that does not answer within its bound is ended, reaped and refused by name, so the history it serves is never held.

data_layer.a_task_control_time_is_its_mi.description: A Task Control time is read as UTC integer microseconds by one rule the log's views share, and refused by name otherwise.

data_layer.a_task_parent_is_its_nearest.description: A task stores its parent task, else its goal held in its own workspace, else its workspace, by its event's version.

data_layer.a_timed_row_needs_its_source_.description: Staging refuses by name a raw_bar or corporate_action row without its source's own write time, which orders it against a held value.

data_layer.a_workspace_attaches_the_cata.description: A workspace connection attaches the catalog read-only only when its instance lacks it, and makes each served view its own.
data_layer.a_workspace_attaches_the_cata.retired: 2026-11-20: the opt-in derived Feature view is retired; no workspace connection attaches the catalog for a view

data_layer.a_workspace_reads_derived_row.description: Under derived, a workspace reader reads the catalog's derived rows under the table's name while its writer keeps the table.
data_layer.a_workspace_reads_derived_row.lower_layer: It attaches a real DuckLake catalog to a real workspace DuckDB file and reads through the workspace's own connections; only both files show it.
data_layer.a_workspace_reads_derived_row.retired: 2026-11-20: the opt-in derived Feature view is retired; Feature values are read from the workspace's table

data_layer.a_world_row_carries_its_provi.description: Staging gives a world row whose key names a provider the lineage it is admitted under, and stages other rows as they came.

data_layer.admission_is_read_as_of_befor.description: One admission's rows share one known_at that never steps back with the wall clock; the as-of read before its correction sees them, after it sees the correction, and the replaced version is superseded in the same commit.
data_layer.admission_is_read_as_of_befor.lower_layer: The as-of read is DuckDB's macro over a real DuckLake catalog.

data_layer.agent_otlp_drops_content_befo.description: Native OTLP attribution and numerical usage survive decoding while prompt, tool, opt-in and unknown content never enters the storage batch.

data_layer.agent_otlp_is_one_catalog_bat.description: Sanitized native observations commit atomically through the catalog's existing writer, even when the Host stops meanwhile, and read under their exact vendor and conversation with absent attribution counted.
data_layer.agent_otlp_is_one_catalog_bat.lower_layer: The contract crosses real DuckLake metadata, Arrow registration and restart persistence.

data_layer.an_ended_trial_awaits_its_rev.description: If an ended trial with no note read as reviewed or as running, an agent would skip its review or wait on work already done.
data_layer.an_ended_trial_awaits_its_rev.lower_layer: It reads the experience view over real projected trial rows, which no single function holds.

data_layer.an_event_names_its_type_versi.description: A new event is written under version 1 of its type unless its writer names a later registered version.

data_layer.an_experience_body_shows_its_.description: If an experience's body omitted its run's seconds, tokens and cost or its measures' place in their spread, its reader could not weigh its verdict.

data_layer.an_experience_renders_again_e.description: If a grown log's experiences did not replay equal, or a body did not render again to the bytes its event named, a reopened Host would cite experiences it cannot reproduce.
data_layer.an_experience_renders_again_e.lower_layer: It replays a real grown log into an empty one and re-renders its stored bodies, which no single function holds.

data_layer.an_owed_list_is_read_whatever.description: An admission snapshot's commit info is read as the events it owes, one envelope written before the list as a list of one, and an unknown version refused.

data_layer.analytics_views_preserve_valu.description: Each analytics view returns every pinned column and row of the fixed Host-written research log.
data_layer.analytics_views_preserve_valu.lower_layer: The views execute DuckDB SQL over the attached SQLite log; a unit test cannot prove both engines' result values.

data_layer.append_admits_only_a_keepable.description: The append boundary refuses by name a missing attribute, an unbound, missing or unexpected text, a malformed count or part, a credential and a live write under a superseded definition.

data_layer.array_bodies_settle_after_a_r.description: A body whose event rolled back, or whose rename after its commit was refused, is settled by the next start in the same process, and the commit's later bodies are placed.
data_layer.array_bodies_settle_after_a_r.lower_layer: A rollback and a commit are a real log's; the refused rename is a real file move.

data_layer.array_digest_names_one_array.description: A digest kept again with another dtype or shape is refused by name, and the array it names stays readable.
data_layer.array_digest_names_one_array.lower_layer: The refusal reads the profile the log holds for the digest.

data_layer.array_door_holds_one_body_per.description: Two workspaces citing one lane hold one body under blobs/, each by its own live_ref, however often each keeps it.
data_layer.array_door_holds_one_body_per.lower_layer: Holds are live_ref rows the log projects; the body is a file under the data root.

data_layer.array_door_keeps_every_lane_k.description: Every lane kind (float with NaN payloads and signed zeros, integer, boolean, several columns, a 2-D shape, legacy packed bytes) kept through the array door reads back bit-exact as columns and as packed bytes, under the digest documents cite.

data_layer.array_door_refuses_a_wrong_dt.description: A body whose dtype, shape or bytes differ from its profile is refused by name, and equal bytes of another dtype or shape are another array.

data_layer.array_start_places_only_a_com.description: Start moves a body a crash left staged into place when the log holds its profile, and collects it when it does not.

data_layer.backup_copies_only_new_files.description: A machine backup copies newly referenced immutable files into its shared pool, reuses unchanged held files and refuses a changed sealed name or a path outside its roots.

data_layer.backup_manifest_is_portable.description: A machine backup manifest names exactly its three databases, a well-formed chain head and unique relative data/blob handles; malformed or escaping handles are refused before restore writes.

data_layer.backup_names_only_its_own_fil.description: If a backup named a file outside its data path as its own, or refused a deletion scheduled in the folder its catalog left, a relocated root would carry or refuse another folder's files.

data_layer.backup_opens_read_only_sqlite.description: A machine backup gives SQLite the same escaped, read-only file URI for an ordinary Windows path and its extended-length spelling.

data_layer.baggage_attributes_every_span.description: A span below W3C headers is their trace's child, carries its baggage's trial and selection and its caller's workspace, is logged live as started, and has its log records as facts inside it.

data_layer.chain_catches_a_rewritten_eve.description: The chain verifies whole and from its last checkpoint, a new log is seeded and checkpointed monthly, and an event rewritten past its trigger breaks the fold.
data_layer.chain_catches_a_rewritten_eve.lower_layer: The chain folds rows of a real SQLite log, rewritten past its trigger.

data_layer.collected_rows_leave_in_one_c.description: The rows of collected artifacts leave every results table in one catalog commit before they leave the deletion queue.
data_layer.collected_rows_leave_in_one_c.lower_layer: A fake catalog session keeps the statements; the integration crash case runs them on a real catalog.

data_layer.configured_export_scrubs_secr.description: A configured span exporter receives admitted secret values redacted, with prompt and result content off unless the person enables it; the local span record stays independent.

data_layer.copy_carries_its_catalog_resu.description: A workspace copy carries its catalog's outcomes and Portfolio results, and the Host opening it admits each its owner proves, holds committed before the files go, refusals releasing only that opening.
data_layer.copy_carries_its_catalog_resu.lower_layer: The carry reads one real catalog and admits onto another through the Host's log and DuckLake writers; no unit can hold two data roots.

data_layer.daily_market_health_counts_ca.description: The Daily records distinct failure counts for freshness, non-null keys, unique versions, action kinds and listing relationships in the world catalog.
data_layer.daily_market_health_counts_ca.lower_layer: Actual DuckDB predicates, parameter binding and joins are required to prove the SQL counts.

data_layer.daily_market_health_names_una.description: An unavailable observation retains every check identity and reports no invented failure counts.

data_layer.data_root_is_set_or_the_appli.description: The data root is ALPHALATTICE_DATA_ROOT when set, else the platform's application data folder.

data_layer.durable_events_commit_at_once.description: A durable event commits when appended and syncs the log's WAL to the disk; an ordinary one commits with its batch, its deadline, or the flush a reply waits for, which a Host killed after the reply keeps.
data_layer.durable_events_commit_at_once.lower_layer: Commit visibility is what another SQLite connection reads, and a kill is a real process's death.

data_layer.each_note_renders_a_versioned.description: If the Host's rendering of a note did not make an experience of its own, versioned by renderer and kept when a later note replaces it, a later note or renderer would overwrite the experience an earlier read cited.
data_layer.each_note_renders_a_versioned.lower_layer: It runs the Host's render over a real log and its stored bodies across a re-render and a replacement.

data_layer.each_work_unit_stores_one_par.description: A task, hypothesis and trial each store exactly one parent, and their workspace, goal and experience are reached by joining up it.
data_layer.each_work_unit_stores_one_par.lower_layer: The parent is chosen in the log's own SQLite projection and checked by its tables; only a real log shows the rows.

data_layer.effective_n_follows_its_formu.description: If effective N left the method's range, a deflated Sharpe ratio built on it would count more trials than were run, or fewer than one.

data_layer.event_ids_are_uuidv7.description: A new event's id is a UUIDv7 whose leading 48 bits are the Unix milliseconds it was minted in.

data_layer.every_body_kind_is_collected_.description: A collected blob, inline body and table rows all go; a crash after the collection event leaves the body queued and the next start removes it, and a collected body is never held again.
data_layer.every_body_kind_is_collected_.lower_layer: A real log, DuckLake catalog and data root.

data_layer.experience_reads_without_bodi.description: The reading views and compare read profiles and measures only: with every artifact body removed, experience returns each trial with its measures and two artifacts compare across a convertible metric version.
data_layer.experience_reads_without_bodi.lower_layer: The views are DuckDB SQL over the attached SQLite log; only both engines run them.

data_layer.expiry_keeps_what_repair_read.description: If expiry took the newest snapshot, a young one, or one from an admission whose event the log lacks on, a reader or the next start's repair would lose the commit it reads.

data_layer.family_declares_old_data_by_h.description: A declared upgrade family names its old data by its holds predicate alone, which defaults to holding nothing, so a family with a reader switch cannot return.

data_layer.goal_trace_breaks_down_a_goal.description: A goal's calls read apart by session, with the agent's time between calls inferred, untraced call time flagged, unattributed calls counted and each stage summed.

data_layer.heavy_work_runs_beside_the_wr.description: An append and its flush made while a large admission is digested and staged wait as an ordinary one does, since staging runs in the process that has the rows and never under the writer.
data_layer.heavy_work_runs_beside_the_wr.lower_layer: The wait is measured on a real log's commits against a second real process.

data_layer.held_files_wait_in_the_deleti.description: A file another handle holds open waits in the deletion queue with its error and tries, and goes at the first start after it is released.
data_layer.held_files_wait_in_the_deleti.lower_layer: Windows' refusal to delete an open file is the operating system's, on a real disk.

data_layer.host_append_is_all_or_nothing.description: Each append writes the event, its text, the chain head, its projection and an inline body as one unit: a refused event leaves no trace and its batch's other events whole.
data_layer.host_append_is_all_or_nothing.lower_layer: The unit is a SQLite transaction and its savepoints; only a real database holds them.

data_layer.host_history_records_or_defer.description: A Host's history records its workspace, its own definitions, begun spans as started then ended with flattened attributes, and facts with their text in their span, and nothing while another Host holds the data root.
data_layer.host_history_records_or_defer.lower_layer: The lock is an operating-system file lock, the history a real SQLite log, and the catalog uses DuckDB.
data_layer.host_history_records_or_defer.retired: 2026-11-15: the history is no longer deferred; a Host whose log does not open does not start, which data_layer.host_history_records_or_refuses proves.

data_layer.host_history_records_or_refus.description: A Host's history records its workspace and definitions, closes with its last Host, shares a catalog surface and closes its cursors, and refuses an unavailable log, views or held data root without retaining a lock.
data_layer.host_history_records_or_refus.lower_layer: The lock is an operating-system file lock, the history a real SQLite log, and the catalog uses DuckDB.

data_layer.kill_inside_append_leaves_the.description: A process killed after an event's row, after its chain fold or after its projection leaves a log the next Host opens whole, with the chain verifying.
data_layer.kill_inside_append_leaves_the.lower_layer: A kill is a real process ending inside a SQLite transaction.

data_layer.knowledge_batches_decode_once.description: Writing the vector index reads each encoded batch once and decodes only its requested rows, each the value a whole-batch decode gives.

data_layer.knowledge_chunks_preserve_cha.description: The chunker honors character capacity, overlap and trimming while preserving offsets into the original text and preferring paragraph, sentence and word boundaries in that order.

data_layer.knowledge_embedding_cache_sur.description: A chunk's recipe-and-model embedding is encoded once in the Host's shared cache and reused by another reader or a rebuild at its calibrated storage precision.
data_layer.knowledge_embedding_cache_sur.lower_layer: Reuse crosses store instances through real SQLite rows and their vector blobs, which a unit double cannot prove.

data_layer.knowledge_fusion_weighs_both_.description: Retrieval scales each channel's scores to [0, 1] and sums them with equal weight, so a chunk both the full-text and the vector channel find outranks one channel's top hit alone; equal scores keep source row order.

data_layer.knowledge_index_projects_scop.description: The vector index projects its scopes again only after an event that changes what they admit, and then admits it; any other event projects nothing.
data_layer.knowledge_index_projects_scop.lower_layer: The scope events and their projections are real SQLite rows of the Host's log, which a unit double cannot prove.

data_layer.knowledge_index_reopens_from_.description: The vector index reopens from its derived files without reading a vector from the log, takes only the chunks after them, and rebuilds files it cannot read, answering alike each time.
data_layer.knowledge_index_reopens_from_.lower_layer: The files' stamp is read against real SQLite chunk rows and the matrix is a real mapped file, which a unit double cannot prove.

data_layer.knowledge_publications_replay.description: A knowledge revision and snapshot retain their source identity, known time and workspace membership when the Host replays its log.
data_layer.knowledge_publications_replay.lower_layer: The authority is the event transaction and its normalized SQLite projections, so replay must read and rebuild a real log.

data_layer.legacy_rows_are_known_from_th.description: StorePort preserves typed catalog rows, derives legacy knowledge from the market's next session close and lag rule, and keeps market and session identities through MIC changes.
data_layer.legacy_rows_are_known_from_th.lower_layer: The lag rule is read from a real log's definition and the session close from a real DuckLake catalog.

data_layer.lexical_leaves_out_common_wor.description: From 10,000 indexed chunks the full-text query leaves out each word at least half the chunks hold, and counts each word again after a chunk is added.

data_layer.lineage_id_is_its_first_regis.description: A first version, task or wait reference, or finished step can introduce a definition lineage from the name that event holds.

data_layer.live_ref_bodies_are_never_col.description: A blob whose artifact a live reference holds is refused deletion by name and stays, while an unheld blob is deleted.
data_layer.live_ref_bodies_are_never_col.lower_layer: The hold is a live_ref row in a real SQLite log.

data_layer.log_refuses_what_its_rules_fo.description: Each rule of the data root's event log refuses its breach by name and leaves the log unchanged.
data_layer.log_refuses_what_its_rules_fo.lower_layer: The rules are SQLite triggers and constraints of log.sql; only a real database holds them.

data_layer.log_views_read_as_defined.description: Each view of the data root's event log reads a settled log as defined, and each hot read uses its index.
data_layer.log_views_read_as_defined.lower_layer: The views and query plans are SQLite's; only a real database holds them.

data_layer.machine_backup_keeps_a_repair.description: A backup captures index before log before catalog during a write burst without holding the Host for the backup; its log names no missing catalog snapshot and restore uses the existing owed-event repair.
data_layer.machine_backup_keeps_a_repair.lower_layer: The interleaving crosses real SQLite backup steps and a committed DuckLake snapshot with the Host writer active.

data_layer.machine_backup_restores_all_r.description: Online snapshots of all three machine databases and the admitted file set restore every retained result ALL EQUAL into a fresh root while workspace backup remains unchanged.
data_layer.machine_backup_restores_all_r.lower_layer: SQLite online backup, SQLite vectors and the DuckLake catalog/file readback require real databases and files.

data_layer.machine_restore_refuses_a_cha.description: Machine restore refuses a changed chain, changed retained bytes or a manifest missing an owned file before publishing the destination.
data_layer.machine_restore_refuses_a_cha.lower_layer: The corruption crosses real copied SQLite/DuckLake owners, retained files and the restore publication boundary.

data_layer.maintenance_bounds_the_catalo.description: If maintenance expired a snapshot whose admission event the log lacks, the next start could not repair it; if it never expired or cleaned up, a collected partition's bytes would stay forever.
data_layer.maintenance_bounds_the_catalo.lower_layer: Expiry and file cleanup are DuckLake's own catalog calls over real Parquet files, read against the log's events; only a real catalog and log show both.

data_layer.market_condition_is_measured_.description: If a market's condition read members or bars known after its cutoff, or a member that had left the universe, a trial's effect would be split by a condition it could not have seen.
data_layer.market_condition_is_measured_.lower_layer: The condition is read through world's point-in-time macros over the lake, so only a real lake shows what was known at the cutoff.

data_layer.model_head_tensors_read_as_fl.description: The reranker's head files read as named float32 tensors with their shapes, and a tensor of another dtype is refused by name.

data_layer.native_events_split_an_agents.description: The time between a conversation's calls splits by its native records into waits on the person, the agent's tools and model requests, each moment counted once, the remainder unattributed; with no records the whole gap stays inferred.

data_layer.one_block_of_admissions_is_on.description: Admissions made in one block share one catalog snapshot, each keeping its own admission and event, and a refusal commits the admissions made before it.
data_layer.one_block_of_admissions_is_on.lower_layer: A snapshot and its repaired events exist only in a real DuckLake catalog and Host log on a data root.

data_layer.one_host_writes_the_data_root.description: A second Host is refused the data root's lock by name with its holder, and other processes read the log through a read-only attach that refuses a write.
data_layer.one_host_writes_the_data_root.lower_layer: The lock is an operating-system file lock and the attach a SQLite connection.

data_layer.one_sqlite_library_opens_the_.description: Only the reading views' own process attaches the log in DuckDB; every other reading session leaves it out, so a process writing the log opens it with one SQLite library.
data_layer.one_sqlite_library_opens_the_.lower_layer: It reads the whole source tree from disk.

data_layer.only_a_host_opens_its_store.description: A process whose Host history is not open gets no StorePort and admits nothing.

data_layer.paths_are_quoted_sql_literals.description: A data root path enters DuckDB SQL as a literal with forward slashes, each quote doubled and a Windows extended-length prefix dropped, so any such path attaches.

data_layer.recall_finds_experiences_as_k.description: Recall finds each experience known at its cutoff with its trials, projecting new experiences first, never encoding a cached vector again, and reranking English only.
data_layer.recall_finds_experiences_as_k.lower_layer: The corpus is a projection of the log's experiences through the store's SQLite tables and FTS5, so the catch-up and the as-of filters need a real log.

data_layer.recall_meets_its_speed_at_100.description: At 100,000 chunks with the real CPU models, recall answers its first query and its p95 within one second in English and Chinese.
data_layer.recall_meets_its_speed_at_100.lower_layer: The target is the whole query path over a real SQLite store, its FTS5 index, the mapped matrix and the installed model packs, so it needs them all.

exception.why: the retrieval store's speed target is read at 100,000 chunks with the real CPU models
exception.decided: 2026-11-18: granted, nightly_only; the requirement is the recall speed at 100,000 chunks, so the scale is the test; the store build embeds 100k chunks on the CPU models (about 100 s)

data_layer.recipe_key_is_its_content.description: A recipe's key is the digest of its method's lineage, version, parameters and upstream recipes, whatever order they are written in, and never a name.

data_layer.repair_appends_each_owed_even.description: Repair appends each event a catalog snapshot carried and the log lacks once, with its writer's envelope and snapshot, at the next start even below the free-space floor that refuses staging.
data_layer.repair_appends_each_owed_even.lower_layer: The owed event is read from a real DuckLake snapshot's commit info and appended through the Host's write path into a real log.

data_layer.replay_rebuilds_every_project.description: Replay reproduces every projected table and the chain head, including minted definition IDs and renames, and names a divergent projection by its table.
data_layer.replay_rebuilds_every_project.lower_layer: A projection is SQL inside the event's own SQLite transaction; only a real database replays it.

data_layer.reranker_head_scores_the_firs.description: The reranker's head scores each pair by its first token through Dense, exact GELU, LayerNorm and a final Dense.

data_layer.research_input_held_by_each_w.description: A research input binding already kept for one workspace is held again by each later workspace that binds it, so no workspace's removal releases it from another.
data_layer.research_input_held_by_each_w.lower_layer: The holds are live_ref rows the log projects from two opened workspaces; only a real log shows them.

data_layer.research_input_path_stays_in_.description: A research-input file laid out outside its binding's folder is refused by name before any log or body is touched.

data_layer.research_input_released_with_.description: Once the last workspace that binds a research input is deleted, its member and manifest bodies are collected and every view that linked them is removed, while other bindings stay.
data_layer.research_input_released_with_.lower_layer: The release is the log's workspace projection, the collector on a real data root and the views' hard links; only those together free the bytes.

data_layer.research_input_seal_is_blake3.description: A research-input file's seal is the BLAKE3 of its bytes, read without loading it whole, for any size the empty file included; a binding's files are listed by their relative POSIX paths.

data_layer.research_input_view_lays_out_.description: A kept research input binding reads as its folder under the holder's view, its pooled database placed once and shared, and an unkept binding is refused by name.

data_layer.research_input_views_go_with_.description: A view of a research input binding whose bodies were collected is removed with each pooled database no kept binding lists, while kept bindings' views stay.

data_layer.research_inputs_carried_into_.description: A workspace copy carries only the bindings its workspace holds, its own root keeps them at open, and a tampered carried body is refused.
data_layer.research_inputs_carried_into_.lower_layer: The holds are live_ref rows the log projects, on two real data roots; only real logs show the carry.

data_layer.research_inputs_kept_once_and.description: A binding's research-input files are kept once under blobs/, held once by each workspace that binds them, and read back as the folder it was bound from, byte for byte; a binding kept again records nothing.
data_layer.research_inputs_kept_once_and.lower_layer: The holds are live_ref rows the log projects; the bodies are files under the data root.

data_layer.research_records_are_named_by.description: Every research record is named by an id, so equal facts never collide or split across workspaces, trials, versions, renames or number forms.
data_layer.research_records_are_named_by.lower_layer: Each record is written by the log's own projection inside its SQLite transaction and read back by its tables and views; only a real log shows the rows.

data_layer.root_created_twice_is_all_equ.description: Creating a data root with installed data dependencies creates the SQLite DuckLake catalog and runs its views and macros offline; repeating creation leaves every file byte-identical, and another schema version is refused by name.
data_layer.root_created_twice_is_all_equ.lower_layer: Creation writes SQLite databases and folders on disk.

data_layer.seed_registry_is_whole.description: The seed registry names each reference definition once as a registered family's version 1, with registry.seeded, the research tags and every artifact type's measures.
data_layer.seed_registry_is_whole.lower_layer: The seed registry is package data the unit layer may not read; the log a data root is born with holds it.

data_layer.spans_are_step_events.description: Each span ended through the OpenTelemetry SDK is appended as its step event with its trace, parent, times, phase, actor and attributes, and a span the log refuses is counted by its code, never raised.
data_layer.spans_are_step_events.lower_layer: The exporter writes into a real Host log through the SDK's span processor.

data_layer.stage_digest_is_canonicals.description: Each world row's value_digest, built over its admission's Arrow columns, is blake3 over canonical() of the row with its provider's lineage, byte for byte, for every column type a row can carry.
data_layer.stage_digest_is_canonicals.retired: 2026-11-17: a world version is named by an engine-minted version_id and judged new by comparing its columns, so no row digest is built

data_layer.stage_refuses_what_it_cannot_.description: Staging refuses by name two versions of one key in one admission, a table StorePort does not admit and a legacy batch with no valid date, before anything is staged.

data_layer.staging_keeps_every_rows_colu.description: Staging writes every column any row of an admission carries, not only the first row's, so a field a later row gives is kept.

data_layer.start_collects_what_no_write_.description: Start collects staging no producer holds and data files the catalog does not name, holding each admission's lock while it does, so a producer's staging is never lost.
data_layer.start_collects_what_no_write_.lower_layer: Collection reads a real DuckLake catalog's file tables and deletes files on disk.

data_layer.store_deletes_only_its_own_fi.description: StorePort refuses by name to delete anything outside the data root's staging, data and blobs folders, before touching the disk.

data_layer.store_research_laws.description: Each registered store keeps the known-time boundary, gives a later restatement only at its own cutoff, keeps one identity for equal evidence, and reads identical typed evidence after restart.

data_layer.storeport_writes_each_derived.description: StorePort writes a derived partition once, valid only for its recipe and inputs, keeps each digest a workspace roots and collects the rest, and makes and widens a feature set's table.
data_layer.storeport_writes_each_derived.lower_layer: The partitions are written into the DuckLake catalog in one transaction and their validity and roots into the log; only a real catalog and log show both.

data_layer.the_schema_meets_its_contract.description: A schema change that breaks a declared identity, link or status rule is refused, including an outside identity code admitted without a cited guarantee that it never changes.
data_layer.the_schema_meets_its_contract.lower_layer: The DDL is read as SQLite and DuckDB build it, the engines the Host runs, so the contract judges the schema they enforce, not a parse of its text.

data_layer.upgrade_stops_before_unverifi.description: An upgrade does no work without verified backups and switches only an ALL EQUAL family; completed steps are not repeated.

data_layer.upgrade_verifies_before_switc.description: First 0.2.8 startup requires verified machine and workspace backups, resumes the first unfinished family after a kill, switches only verified ALL EQUAL families and serves no failed upgrade.
data_layer.upgrade_verifies_before_switc.lower_layer: The runner records durable progress in a real Host log and a killed child must resume with the old reader retained until verification.

data_layer.vector_table_defers_without_e.description: Without extension loading a data root still creates every index table but the vector table, and names that table deferred.
data_layer.vector_table_defers_without_e.lower_layer: The index is a SQLite database on disk, built through the extension loader.
data_layer.vector_table_defers_without_e.retired: 2026-11-18: the data root makes no index.sqlite and loads no extension; the knowledge store's search lives in log.sqlite as FTS5 and a NumPy matrix, proved by data_layer.knowledge_embedding_cache_survives_its_readers

data_layer.workspace_copy_carries_its_la.description: A workspace copy opened on its own data root reads every lane its source held, carried in the old lane form and moved onto its own log when its Host opens.
data_layer.workspace_copy_carries_its_la.lower_layer: The copy opens a second real data root and log in the same process.

data_layer.write_order_recovers_from_a_k.description: A Host killed at each write-order point of an observed, results or array write leaves no half write: the next start finds all of it or none, its event once, and no staging.
data_layer.write_order_recovers_from_a_k.lower_layer: A kill is a real process's death between a real DuckLake commit and a real log append.

exception.why: a real process killed at each write-order point of the observed, results and array writers; a kill needs a real process
exception.decided: 2026-11-18: over the medium admission seconds as on develop; its process cases fall 9 -> 8 and its seconds stay at or below 60

data_platform.session_authority_is_conte.description: The Host resolves one trading calendar: weekends are covered but are not sessions, and one range always seals the same axis while a narrower range seals another.

egress.market_session_checks_native_requ.description: The market SDK's native session checks its timeout, each destination and the process offline switch before native sends.
egress.market_session_checks_native_requ.lower_layer: The contract checks that the installed market SDK actually uses the supplied session and that it runs the destination check on its native request path.

egress.outbound_checks_each_destination.description: The outbound HTTP reader checks each destination, including redirects and the process offline switch, before the transport sends.
egress.outbound_checks_each_destination.lower_layer: The installed client's redirect implementation must call the guard before each native transport request, which a unit test of the guard cannot show.

evaluation.answer_observer_judges_its_ow.description: A test's teardown judges the answers of the Hosts it or a wider fixture started and fails naming their Task; another scope's Host neither fails it nor goes unsaid.

evaluation.answer_observer_scopes_real_h.description: A real Host records the test or fixture scope that started it before any test opens, and its stopped Task's answer fails only a test of that scope, naming the Task and the Host.
evaluation.answer_observer_scopes_real_h.lower_layer: Its behaviour is pytest's own fixture scopes, a real Host's construction and the wrapped operation door the root conftest installs.

evaluation.continuation_snapshot_integri.description: A native acceptance continuation admits only the exact tracked bytes written by its recorded prestart configure and refuses other tracked changes.

evaluation.first_failed_native_phase_end.description: A controller run ends at its first native phase with a nonzero exit, NATIVE_FAILED, and a run whose phases all exit zero ends STOPPED_BY_HARNESS, with its owner and Host stopped either way.
evaluation.first_failed_native_phase_end.lower_layer: The controller's phase loop references the native turn monitor, which imports subprocess, and the unit layer refuses it; the table stands in the owner and the monitor and starts no process.

evaluation.golden_consumers_queue_behind.description: Under a parallel run, a session golden's first consumer keeps its place and builds it, and its other consumers are queued where the recorded work ahead passes that build, or last when it is unrecorded, never blocked on its lock.

evaluation.launch_form_binds_its_owner.description: A native run's launch form decides its process owner: an owned Job alone, or a named owner inside its bound checkout; another binding or an unknown form is refused by name before an owner exists.

evaluation.listener_boundary_samples_sur.description: A replay monitor samples the local Host at both declared ACK markers before acknowledging them, including when work ends before the next periodic sample.

exception.why: A real Host exercises the sampled ACK markers
exception.decided: 2026-10-29: approved; real Host sampling exercises the ACK markers

evaluation.live_read_watches_every_task.description: A native run's live read keeps every Task it has seen current past the Host's per-page watch cap, so a leg sees its goal end.
evaluation.live_read_watches_every_task.lower_layer: The live reader joins paginated Host activity with task state and its persisted cursor, which an isolated decision cannot prove.

evaluation.native_first_use_keeps_the_ho.description: Native first use starts the Claude host with its session persistence and the ordinary agent's shipped tools and guidance, and offers PowerShell only on Windows.
evaluation.native_first_use_keeps_the_ho.lower_layer: The host argv builder lives in the intent provider, which imports subprocess, and the unit layer refuses a module that imports subprocess.

evaluation.native_gate_verdicts_follow_t.description: Each native release gate's verdict comes from one leg's own graded results, and a result the leg did not grade is a failed gate.

evaluation.native_hosts_stop_with_their_.description: A native acceptance run stops its own recorded workspace Hosts and proves each listener and process ended, or names the unproved stop.

evaluation.native_leg_stop_owns_process_.description: A requested native leg stop ends only its recorded driver and descendants, completes its own teardown and records any unproved cleanup.

evaluation.native_leg_stops_by_name.description: One command starts, resumes and collects a native leg of either host, and every stop carries a named reason and its evidence.

evaluation.native_phase_keeps_its_observ.description: A real native phase reads its prompt and a Host asset, keeps its stream, process and memory records, and keeps a failed memory reading as an incomplete row naming its error.
evaluation.native_phase_keeps_its_observ.lower_layer: Its behaviour is a real child process, its loopback read and the process records the monitor samples.

evaluation.native_snapshot_tolerates_pro.description: A native activity snapshot continues when an observed process exits or becomes inaccessible before sampling, preserving other observed processes.

evaluation.native_turn_cleanup_wait_is_f.description: A native turn refuses a zero, infinite or undefined cleanup wait by name before it starts a process or writes a receipt.
evaluation.native_turn_cleanup_wait_is_f.lower_layer: The native turn monitor imports subprocess and psutil, and the unit layer refuses a module that imports subprocess.

evaluation.one_leg_serves_every_native_g.description: A finished native leg runs the upgrade axis over its own recorded grades without changing its state, takes the scenario's settled date, and names a scenario person's stop.
evaluation.one_leg_serves_every_native_g.lower_layer: The native leg's driver and the upgrade entry import process facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

evaluation.persistent_golden_root_follow.description: The persistent golden cache root is the operator's shared setting when present and the checkout's own folder when absent.

evaluation.person_ask_posts_each_questio.description: The scenario person's ASK posts each question as one bounded process with its record and question filled in, and records the exit and words, or the start failure, beside the record; no ASK command posts nothing.
evaluation.person_ask_posts_each_questio.lower_layer: The poster's whole job is starting one bounded process and recording its exit, and the unit layer refuses a module that imports subprocess.

evaluation.pre_session_time_stays_apart_.description: A native run's process time keeps an invocation that never opened a session apart from its measured turns, and a phase without its output reads unavailable, never zero.

evaluation.release_gates_run_as_one_insp.description: The native release gates run as one Inspect AI task over each host's one prepared leg, with every gate's verdict and the scenario person's questions in its log.
evaluation.release_gates_run_as_one_insp.lower_layer: The task runs Inspect AI's evaluation loop and a leg process, which the unit layer cannot load.

evaluation.scenario_person_answers_and_g.description: The scenario person answers from the script, the fact sheet or a bounded ask, says it does not know past the bound, stops by name only on a Host question not named nonblocking, and records every question when asked.

evaluation.sessionless_first_use_questio.description: A sessionless first-use question is attributed only when its authenticated Host record matches the sole verified workspace and goal identity.

factor_research.curation_and_handoff_are.description: If Factor curation or Alpha handoff trained a model or depended on its actor, a recorded decision would not reopen safely.

feature_engine.aligned_gap_names_missing.description: An unavailable formula names an aligned missing observation within its declared source window, retaining the formula's calendar horizon and economic skip.
feature_engine.aligned_gap_names_missing.lower_layer: The installed observation clocks, calendar alignment and the real vectorized materializer meet at this boundary.

feature_engine.closure_folder_files_hold.description: A closure folder writes each file whole, lists its files sorted, reads them back and removes one without touching the rest, so a Panel closure outside a workspace keeps every byte it is given.

feature_engine.closure_folder_lists_file.description: A closure folder lists its files by their last write, the newest last, and a staged file is none of them, so the move keeps each folder's write order.

feature_engine.closure_history_folds_its.description: If the closure ledger rebuilt a history from anything but its map and revisions, a Feature panel would mix sector facts from another time.

feature_engine.closure_ledger_survives_a.description: If the closure ledger lost its place across a failed store write or misread its revisions, Feature panels would rebuild wrongly or recompute published work.

feature_engine.closure_moves_onto_the_lo.description: The upgrade keeps every file of a workspace's Panel closure folder on the log under its hold, reads each back equal, and the closure store then reads its children there.
feature_engine.closure_moves_onto_the_lo.lower_layer: The family reads a real closure folder and writes a real log and data root.

feature_engine.closure_pointer_requires_.description: Feature closure pointers reject a partial or noncanonical content identity before looking up a head.

feature_engine.closure_store_switch_refu.description: The closure store's switch accepts only the log and the legacy folder, and refuses any other value by name before any store is read.
feature_engine.closure_store_switch_refu.retired: 2026-11-20: ALPHALATTICE_CLOSURE_STORE is retired; the unmoved-folder rule alone picks the closure's reader

feature_engine.closure_store_takes_only_.description: If the coordinator handed the store identities it never derived, a Feature store could hold its data under another closure's name.

feature_engine.closure_writes_go_to_the_.description: After the move the closure store writes only to the log, across a restart, and leaves the folder unchanged.
feature_engine.closure_writes_go_to_the_.lower_layer: The closure store writes a real log and reads a real folder.

feature_engine.current_pointer_swaps_fai.description: If the current panel pointer moved without its compare and swap, two writers could leave readers on a publication neither finished.

feature_engine.derived_feature_reads_equ.description: Under derived, each workspace's Feature writes reach the catalog and every read takes values equal to its own table's, whatever another workspace builds or drops.
feature_engine.derived_feature_reads_equ.lower_layer: It writes through a real workspace DuckDB into a real DuckLake catalog in an open Host history and reads back through both; only all three show it.
feature_engine.derived_feature_reads_equ.retired: 2026-11-20: the opt-in derived Feature reads are retired; the stored table is the one reader

feature_engine.factor_handoff_refuses_a_.description: If a Factor handoff accepted a corrupt copy, a changed source or a tampered kept body, Alpha research would train on inputs its binding never named.
feature_engine.factor_handoff_refuses_a_.lower_layer: The refusals come from a real binding over a real Factor-scale workspace, its kept bodies on the data root and the Panel reader; no unit holds those together.

feature_engine.handoff_binds_logical_clo.description: If an Alpha handoff changed its original Factor inputs or failed to bind the logical panel closure, a later reader could use a different dataset.
feature_engine.handoff_binds_logical_clo.lower_layer: A real workspace binding and its persisted Panel closure are read before and after the handoff.

feature_engine.kept_closure_names_follow.description: A moved closure folder lists its kept files by name and by last write, and a removed file is gone from both listings and reads as absent.
feature_engine.kept_closure_names_follow.lower_layer: The listing reads a real log's events.

feature_engine.logical_identity_moves_on.description: If logical identity followed encoding, write batches or policy instead of content, reuse would serve changed values or rebuild unchanged panels.

feature_engine.materialized_source_ident.description: A materialized source identity distinguishes missing observations from numerical zero at each session.

feature_engine.panel_chunks_stay_bound_t.description: If a panel chunk's bytes or hash drifted from the binding that wrote it, a reader would accept data under an identity it never had.

feature_engine.panel_records_sessions_wi.description: A Panel records each listing's sessions without a bar inside its own span, reads its record back only as written, and records nothing when every span is complete.

feature_engine.retired_tables_mark_a_wor.description: Only a base table 0.2.7 retired marks a workspace before 0.2.7 and is refused by name; the view and runs 0.2.7 left pass.

feature_engine.sector_map_entries_take_w.description: A sector map's entries take world's Sector names with their provenance kept, and a listing world does not classify is refused by name.

feature_engine.sector_maps_read_their_na.description: A sector map's first Host read selects it when world holds exactly its names; its readers then take world's names at that cutoff, else the map's own entries.
feature_engine.sector_maps_read_their_na.lower_layer: The selection and world's names are the Host's log and catalog, which the unit layer cannot open.

feature_engine.source_prefix_proof_tells.description: If materialization identity blurred null, NaN, signed zero or absent rows, or kept a sealed year after a write, stale Feature stores would pass as current.

feature_engine.the_feature_read_setting_.description: The Feature read setting is stored by default, derived when set so, and refused by name otherwise.

feature_engine.workspace_before_0_2_7_re.description: A workspace an earlier release than 0.2.7 last opened is refused by name before its Feature schema is touched.
feature_engine.workspace_before_0_2_7_re.lower_layer: The retired tables are read from a real workspace DuckDB database; only it shows them.

knowledge.a_new_authority_takes_the_int8.description: If a new Evidence authority did not take the int8 recipe, or an installed one lost its own recipe on a rebind, first use stays slow or old indexes stop matching.

knowledge.int8_canary_is_proved_live_at_.description: If an int8 session loaded at the CPU budget's threads without equalling the canary one thread gives on this machine, threads could move retrieval numbers unseen.
knowledge.int8_canary_is_proved_live_at_.retired: 2026-11-19: the retired retrieval core's session pool, whose threads the canary judged, is gone; the retrieval store opens no shared session

knowledge.int8_recipe_is_the_retained_mo.description: If the int8 recipe named other models, shared a sealed canary, installed over the fp32 packs or shared identities across machine classes, results from different machines would mix.
knowledge.int8_recipe_is_the_retained_mo.retired: 2026-11-19: the retired retrieval core's per-machine int8 identities are gone; the recipe a new authority takes is proved by knowledge.a_new_authority_takes_the_int8_recipe

local_application.a_disconnected_waiter_.description: When a Host stays unavailable through the wait cap the answer reports that the Task continues.
local_application.a_disconnected_waiter_.lower_layer: The real local client imports process and Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

local_application.a_goal_is_found_by_its.description: A reopened goal is found by its declaration's typed binary hash with its opener and encoding version, never by JSON text.

local_application.a_recall_query_and_lim.description: If a recall's empty, over-long or out-of-range query or limit reached a model, the model would embed or rank an unbounded request before the Host named the error.

local_application.a_refused_body_drain_e.description: If a refused request's body were drained with no overall deadline, a client trickling bytes could hold a request thread without end.
