exception.decided: 2026-11-16: granted: one unit test per bounded loop is the goal's proof, each one function under 30 lines with no fixture world; source falls because dead code is deleted, which the growth rule never weighs against new proof

local_application.agent_exporters_previe.description: Native exporter setup previews both agents without writes and, only on explicit consent, merges Claude's project-local environment while leaving user configuration and other settings unchanged.
local_application.agent_exporters_previe.lower_layer: It crosses the native setup owner, real project files and the served Host's connection descriptor.

local_application.agent_otlp_keeps_host_.description: Native binary and JSON OTLP use only the existing authenticated loopback routes, and the handler receives sanitized numerical rows rather than payload text.
local_application.agent_otlp_keeps_host_.lower_layer: The real HTTP owner calls client admission and Host observation, which import process owners outside the unit layer.

local_application.cli_request_keeps_read.description: The bounded CLI carrier receives read admission through its authenticated operation route, so it never renews the Host idle deadline and remains admissible while writes are stopping.

local_application.codex_first_use_names_.description: Codex's trust of a project is read as Codex documents it: an untrusted project gets the person's one step, an explicitly untrusted one names their setting, and a trusted one is ready.

local_application.configure_offers_a_wor.description: A sandboxed configure offers the default new workspace when none exists and a coded choice when existing workspaces need selection.

local_application.configure_offers_missi.description: Sandboxed configure offers each missing setup prerequisite in order before its serve command.

local_application.console_entry_imports_.description: The packaged CLI entry imports only standard-library dependencies before it chooses the running Host or the full CLI.
local_application.console_entry_imports_.lower_layer: An isolated Python import proves the process import closure without sharing previously loaded modules.

local_application.doctor_names_windows_l.description: The doctor and no-Host refusal identify authenticated project Hosts; the Windows doctor reports long-path support and a packaged shell's potentially redirected model store.

local_application.each_command_is_one_ca.description: Each CLI command is one call span, its own trace's root, live before it ends, over its Host steps, acting for its session and linked to that session's previous call.
local_application.each_command_is_one_ca.lower_layer: The span crosses the real CLI, a live Host and its history's SQLite log.

local_application.first_use_offers_deleg.description: A first-use plan offers its delegated network action immediately without waiting for the separate coded daily-consent answer.

local_application.first_use_question_onl.description: An exact first-use Goal retry asks the daily question while unanswered and stops offering it after the person answers.

local_application.goal_revisions_enter_t.description: A new goal is recorded once, a conclusion is drawn, and the person's supporting or rejecting response to one is feedback.

local_application.long_windows_model_sto.description: A model-store status at a long Windows path saves the complete answer without creating the store or replacing an existing output.
local_application.long_windows_model_sto.lower_layer: The real script writes and reads its output at a Windows long-path boundary, which an in-memory decision cannot prove.

local_application.native_tool_setup_uses.description: The offered locked tool setup runs its existing steps with checkout-owned Windows scratch and removes the scratch on success or failure.

local_application.network_question_only_.description: The coded network question is put where a closed workspace control or the closed default holds the network, and never while it is open or the operator's switch holds it offline.

local_application.node_invocation_preser.description: Node test invocation preserves availability and caller environment while resolving absolute browser directory aliases to their physical targets.

local_application.only_reconnects_named_.description: A waiter propagates an unrelated client refusal instead of treating it as a restart.
local_application.only_reconnects_named_.lower_layer: The real local client imports process and Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

local_application.playwright_setup_refus.description: Playwright setup refuses linked or unverifiable installation paths before mutating them while preserving independently owned physical installations.

local_application.research_runs_are_reco.description: A sealed research run is a trial with its selection, recipe, evidence artifact and optional running Task; attribution preserves content identity, a direct rerun has no Task, and the history replays ALL EQUAL.
local_application.research_runs_are_reco.lower_layer: The run is the real workflow over a real workspace, and the history a real SQLite log.

local_application.retrieval_setup_uses_w.description: Retrieval setup gives its Windows subprocesses a temporary directory inside the writable checkout and removes it after use.

market_data_ops.a_membership_transition_.description: A move from one member set to the next is recorded as its exits and then its entries, numbered on from the given sequence.

market_data_ops.a_rate_limited_retry_bac.description: If a rate-limited provider call were retried at once, the retry would hit the same limit and hammer the provider.

market_data_ops.a_research_copy_is_named.description: Only a database in a research-input binding's source folder is a copy that reads world through its selection; every other database reads as before.

market_data_ops.a_research_copy_reads_wo.description: A research-input copy bound in a Host reads world's market values as of its selection, equal to its own tables and unmoved by a later correction, and reads its own tables without one.
market_data_ops.a_research_copy_reads_wo.lower_layer: The selection is a log row, and world's as-of reads, the copy's marks and the Host's admission need a real catalog, log and workspace database.

market_data_ops.a_reverted_mapping_is_ad.description: A mapping changed and then reverted after an admission that took none of it is admitted each time, so world's newest version is the reverted one.
market_data_ops.a_reverted_mapping_is_ad.lower_layer: Admission reads a real workspace database into a real catalog, which only an opened data root holds.

market_data_ops.a_standard_names_its_his.description: If onboarding floored history at a fixed ten years, or a manifest named the original standard whatever floor was applied, a shorter standard would be refused or admitted under a false identity.

market_data_ops.an_action_is_one_world_r.description: A 0.2.7 corporate action becomes one world row keeping its kind as its id and its original payload digest as source metadata, or is refused by name.

market_data_ops.bars_are_admitted_in_who.description: A provider's bars are admitted as consecutive whole years while their count fits a bound, a year over it alone.

market_data_ops.binding_names_a_copy_by_.description: A research-input copy is named only by its place under research-inputs with a binding hash, so any other database reads its own tables, never another binding's selection.

market_data_ops.daily_provider_conforman.description: Every daily market-data provider, the yfinance adapter and each shared fake, answers bars, actions and adjusted closes in the port's shape: exactly the requested symbols, every field finite, inside the window, ascending and split-sound.

market_data_ops.daily_provider_research_.description: Each registered daily provider includes the cutoff session, excludes following sessions and reopens the same provider evidence.

market_data_ops.hydration_provider_confo.description: Every one-response history provider returns the daily port's own rows with in-window actions, adjusted closes and repaired sessions that name only those rows.

market_data_ops.market_reads_setting_is_.description: The market reads setting is world when unset, names world or the workspace when set, and refuses any other value by name.
market_data_ops.market_reads_setting_is_.retired: 2026-11-20: ALPHALATTICE_MARKET_READS is retired; world is the market reader, with the workspace's tables before admission

market_data_ops.market_upgrade_is_all_eq.description: An older workspace's market tables enter a new root through the acknowledged upgrade family and compare ALL EQUAL before world readers are selected.
market_data_ops.market_upgrade_is_all_eq.lower_layer: The Host log, backup authorities and DuckLake catalog must verify a real family's durable admission, reader switch and typed old/new value comparison.

market_data_ops.reference_rows_are_known.description: StorePort reads the lag rule world admits listings, provider symbols and universe members under as counted from their valid date, and the bars' and corporate actions' from their session's close.

market_data_ops.sector_provider_conforma.description: Every current-sector provider names itself and the symbol asked, gives a stripped sector and a 64-hex payload hash, answers alike twice, and refuses an unknown symbol with a typed provider failure.

market_data_ops.set_quality_inputs_match.description: Set-scoped quality inputs match the persisted admissions, closes and actions returned by each listing reader.
market_data_ops.set_quality_inputs_match.lower_layer: A real DuckDB store and Arrow result are needed to compare the persisted set query with its per-listing readers.

market_data_ops.world_holds_the_workspac.description: A workspace's market rows are published into world equal row for row, and a later correction is known from the time its writer observed it.
market_data_ops.world_holds_the_workspac.lower_layer: The 0.2.7 tables are written by their own owner, the world tables through a real StorePort, DuckLake catalog and log.

market_data_ops.world_relations_read_as_.description: Each workspace market table a value read names has a world relation of the same name, read through world's as-of macros at the cutoff given.

market_data_ops.world_serves_only_an_adm.description: World serves no market read from an admission that dropped a workspace row written at the same time as its own version; the workspace's tables answer.
market_data_ops.world_serves_only_an_adm.retired: 2026-11-20: the read verdict is deleted; world serves every read outside a writing stage

market_data_ops.world_serves_the_workspa.description: World serves every market read outside a writing stage; a stage reads its buffer and publishes once at its end, and a write no Host published is read by no one outside it.
market_data_ops.world_serves_the_workspa.lower_layer: World's reads, the Host's publish and the workspace's journal need a real catalog, log and workspace database.

observation_runtime.history_reads_answer.description: If a correlated read followed another run, schema or a partial handle, or picked one of two matches, callers would credit evidence the history does not hold.
observation_runtime.history_reads_answer.lower_layer: Its proof reads events the Host's log really admitted, so it needs the log's SQLite and a written workspace.

observation_runtime.ledger_has_one_sqlit.description: If two writers shared the store or a reader blocked the writer, ledger rows could interleave or the Host would stall recording.
observation_runtime.ledger_has_one_sqlit.retired: 2026-11-16: the observation ledger retired; the activity's records are written by the Host log's one writer, whose lock and batches the data layer proves.

observation_runtime.ledger_reads_answer_.description: If a bounded or correlated read followed a wrong run or hid a tampered row, callers would credit evidence the ledger does not hold.
observation_runtime.ledger_reads_answer_.retired: 2026-11-16: the observation ledger retired; its reads are answered from the Host's history, proved by observation_runtime.history_reads_answer_exactly_or_refuse.

observation_runtime.ledger_records_each_.description: If a repeated, corrected or failed append changed the observation ledger, its record of what happened could no longer be replayed or trusted.
observation_runtime.ledger_records_each_.retired: 2026-11-16: the observation ledger retired; an agent event's replay is reused once from the history, proved by the external-document test, and corrections were never written.

observation_runtime.ledger_refuses_what_.description: If secrets, private cognition or unbacked decisions reached an append, the ledger would keep them durably or claim authority nobody gave.
observation_runtime.ledger_refuses_what_.retired: 2026-11-16: the observation ledger retired; the recording policy that refuses those records stays, proved by observation_runtime.records_refuse_what_they_must_never_hold.

observation_runtime.ledger_stays_inside_.description: If retention ignored the workspace cap or compacted protected rows partially, the ledger would fill the disk or silently lose records it promised to keep.
observation_runtime.ledger_stays_inside_.retired: 2026-11-16: the observation ledger and its retention retired; the activity's records live in the Host log, whose retention is the data layer's.

observation_runtime.process_is_held_to_h.description: A runner binds its process to at most half the machine's logical processors, or to the narrower allowance it already inherited, and reads the bound back from the operating system.

observation_runtime.records_refuse_what_.description: If secrets, private cognition or unbacked decisions passed the recording policy, the Host's history would keep them durably or claim authority nobody gave.

observation_runtime.usage_recording_expo.description: If a usage callback's failure or free text reached owner health, recording could break or private native paths and prose could leak to readers.

pipeline.a_boundary_import_is_refused_at.description: If the merge gate missed a changed import across the release boundary, a public file would ship depending on private code.

pipeline.a_change_that_would_conflict_wi.description: If a change that conflicts with develop passed the commit, the merge queue would refuse it only after review; the commit refuses it at once by name, as the harness's commit does with main.
pipeline.a_change_that_would_conflict_wi.lower_layer: The check asks Git to merge a staged tree into a real develop branch, so only a real repository can show the conflict it refuses.

pipeline.a_gate_tool_off_its_lock_is_ref.description: If a gate tool's installed version differed from uv.lock, an older Ruff would pass a commit without the rules it lacks, with no word of why.

pipeline.a_row_skipped_for_documents_nam.description: A provider may record a row as skipped for a change of documents only by naming those documents, and such a row classes no red.

pipeline.a_stage_reuses_the_hooks_pass_f.description: If a stage ran again a step the hook passed on the same tree and inputs, each card would wait twice for one verdict; if it reused one on another tree, base, target or interpreter, a red would pass unjudged.

pipeline.code_health_reports_every_row.description: The daily code-health report reads sizes, boundaries, growers, dead code, dependencies and complexity from the tree, reuses an unchanged tree's rows, and reads a failed row as unmeasured, never zero.

pipeline.cost_receipt_contains_required_.description: A cost commit stage runs required Small and Medium test families and records their bounded outcomes; slow tests run separately.

pipeline.definition_refuses_malformed_ro.description: A malformed pipeline definition is refused on load by code, naming its stage or row, and the shipped definition loads.

pipeline.development_labels_cannot_grow_.description: If the development-label allowance could grow or reset, internal card and line names would leak into public files with nothing refusing them.

pipeline.every_child_check_names_its_fin.description: Each child check the fast guard runs prints its findings in the guard's own log, under its name and verdict, whether that log is a console, a pipe or a file.
pipeline.every_child_check_names_its_fin.lower_layer: The loss is a process boundary: only a real child process whose parent writes to a pipe or a file can show its words reaching that log.

pipeline.flake_quarantine_candidates.description: The test-health owner derives quarantine candidates from distinct verified flake observations, registered owners and review dates.

pipeline.public_closure_needs_every_file.description: If a public file could import, link, run or read a private file, the published checkout would break for its users or point at private work.

pipeline.public_durations_come_from_juni.description: The public tests' durations file comes from JUnit records: the latest run of each node wins, skipped and out-of-tree nodes are left out, and an unreadable record refuses by name.

pipeline.public_manifest_settles_every_f.description: If the manifest guessed, skipped a file or let a public consumer pull private tools out, private work would escape in the next export.

pipeline.public_outputs_need_a_declared_.description: If a generated output counted as public without its declaration, write and proved sources, a private path or stale file could ship in the export.

pipeline.public_review_never_copies_a_di.description: If the manifest copied a disclosure's text or kept a review after its line changed, a secret could enter Git or an unreviewed edit could ship.

pipeline.public_snapshot_holds_only_prov.description: If the snapshot took a blob the manifest does not prove or added private history, the export would publish bytes nobody reviewed.

pipeline.public_worker_timeout_diagnosti.description: A public worker crash prints its matching active timeout event while a crash without a timeout stays distinct.

pipeline.readmes_name_project_release.description: Both public READMEs name the project version as their current release in the heading, current-release sentence, notes link and last-checked line.
pipeline.readmes_name_project_release.lower_layer: The check reads the tracked project and both README files together.

pipeline.receipt_classes_every_red.description: Each red node and non-passing stage row classes as a defect, flake, slow test, load or tooling from its own evidence, and a red with no evidence reads unclassified, never a defect.

pipeline.receipt_plugin_writes_each_node.description: The receipt plugin writes each test node once, after its last phase or a crash, with its failure's masked signature, and then disposes of itself.

pipeline.receipt_verifies_only_complete_.description: A stage receipt verifies only when every announced event arrived and it meets the requested stage, host, head, result and optional passing test and time-limit checks.

pipeline.result_cache_hits_only_on_uncha.description: A result-cache entry hits only while every file, listing, probe and variable value its group read is unchanged, and its declared key is the same.
pipeline.result_cache_hits_only_on_uncha.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_never_trusts_a_bad.description: A result-cache entry that is damaged, of another schema or key, or names a path outside its checkout is a miss, and a store or tree that cannot be used turns the cache off by its reason.
pipeline.result_cache_never_trusts_a_bad.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_refuses_undeclared.description: A recorder observes collection and execution inputs, storing only complete first-attempt passing results and declining opaque readers or bound native predicates without changing test outcomes.
pipeline.result_cache_refuses_undeclared.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_runner_serves_veri.description: The runner reuses only verified passing groups, records cache provenance, and runs misses or shadow comparisons without hiding changed or opaque inputs.
pipeline.result_cache_runner_serves_veri.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.result_cache_store_stays_within.description: The result-cache store drops entries idle past 14 days and then the oldest while it holds more bytes than its cap.
pipeline.result_cache_store_stays_within.retired: 2026-10-28: a tree-keyed stage cache replaced the per-file input recorder; its holders were deleted with it.

pipeline.shipped_instruction_links_reach.description: If a shipped instruction linked outside the checkout, an installed agent would follow a dead path during its first use.

pipeline.slow_guards_run_when_the_change.description: A slow whole-tree guard runs in the commit stage when its own selection row says the change touches what it reads, and a change touching none of it runs none.
pipeline.slow_guards_run_when_the_change.lower_layer: The selection reads the real registry's rows and parses each changed file's text on both sides, which a unit fixture of rows alone cannot hold.

pipeline.stage_runs_each_row_by_one_prov.description: A stage run resolves each row on its host to exactly one provider, refusing a row with none or two, and writes a receipt that verifies.

pipeline.stage_target_is_separate_from_s.description: A stage enforces its declared stop while recording wall time, the reported rows and any unexplained time from which its target breach and timing gap can be derived.

pipeline.static_refusals_are_named_in_on.description: The fast guard runs every independent static check to its end, side by side in their own processes, and names each refusal and each unrunnable check in one attempt, before any slow step.
pipeline.static_refusals_are_named_in_on.lower_layer: The guard's main sequences its checks in one process over a tree, and no unit test of one check can show that all of them run to their ends.

pipeline.the_hook_keeps_its_bytecode_out.description: If the hook obeyed a caller's ban on bytecode, every check would compile the product's modules again on every commit; if it wrote bytecode into the checkout, the tree would carry caches.
pipeline.the_hook_keeps_its_bytecode_out.lower_layer: The hook's runner imports pre-commit and the process helpers it launches the hooks with, which no unit test may load; its environment is set where it runs.

pipeline.the_hook_leaves_whole_tree_chec.description: If the hook ran the checks that read the whole tree, each commit would wait half a minute; the commit stage runs them, and strict typing runs when its inputs are staged.
pipeline.the_hook_leaves_whole_tree_chec.retired: 2026-11-15: the hook runs every check that judges a change, side by side; pipeline.the_hook_runs_every_check_that_judges_a_change proves it.

pipeline.the_hook_runs_every_check_that_.description: If the hook left a check that judges a change to the commit stage, its red would cost a whole stage instead of seconds; strict typing runs once its cache is warm.

pipeline.the_whole_public_tree_closes_at.description: If the release tree stopped closing over its manifest, the export would publish a file whose dependency users cannot get, with the gate silent.

portfolio_strategy_lab.advancement_refus.description: An advancement receipt index for one program cannot name another program.
portfolio_strategy_lab.advancement_refus.lower_layer: The real advancement store closes over registered publication backends; this holder opens its artifact index instead of replacing those dependencies with a unit double.

portfolio_strategy_lab.finalization_ledg.description: If finalization repeated a step, closed a permit twice or released another package's receipt, a protected result could publish without its own ledger.

portfolio_strategy_lab.finalization_requ.description: A finalization cannot reopen a candidate that was never committed in its own ledger.
portfolio_strategy_lab.finalization_requ.lower_layer: The finalization store's real dependencies include Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

portfolio_strategy_lab.heterogeneous_clo.description: A sealed heterogeneous score closure reopens the same component models, Feature surfaces, listing axis and authority before it predicts.
portfolio_strategy_lab.heterogeneous_clo.lower_layer: The closure reader verifies sealed child files and projects the combined model and surface authority across owners.

portfolio_strategy_lab.heterogeneous_mod.description: A heterogeneous score model-set identity binds the component recipe and the ordered vintage and seed children, and a recipe move only applies to its recorded role.
portfolio_strategy_lab.heterogeneous_mod.lower_layer: The test follows the manifest and child files through admission and the persisted recipe-successor registry.

portfolio_strategy_lab.lane_files_are_th.description: A workspace's Strategy Lab lane files are its Parquet and legacy packed lanes named by a digest, never the ledger's namespaces, the carried lanes or the documents' category.

portfolio_strategy_lab.lane_files_move_i.description: The upgrade moves every Strategy Lab lane file of a workspace into the array door, its ledger's lanes, carried lanes and documents left out, reads each back equal to its file, and stops naming the workspace as holding old lanes.
portfolio_strategy_lab.lane_files_move_i.lower_layer: The family reads real lane files and writes a real log and data root.

portfolio_strategy_lab.lane_reader_switc.description: ALPHALATTICE_ARRAY_STORE=legacy reads the lane files the Strategy Lab store wrote before the door, the upgrade's old switch selects it, and any value but door or legacy is refused by name.
portfolio_strategy_lab.lane_reader_switc.lower_layer: The legacy reader is the old content store reading real lane files, its own file facts included.
portfolio_strategy_lab.lane_reader_switc.retired: 2026-11-20: ALPHALATTICE_ARRAY_STORE is retired; the door is the lanes' reader, with the unmoved-files rule before the upgrade

portfolio_strategy_lab.ledger_index_tell.description: If a persisted ledger index could not tell a lost child from a bad index, recovery would rerun tampered work or refuse honest loss.

portfolio_strategy_lab.listing_axis_orde.description: If reordered listings hashed the same, two different portfolio paths would share one identity and advancement could reuse the wrong one.

portfolio_strategy_lab.unmoved_workspace.description: A workspace that holds lane files the door lacks reads them, the lanes a copy carries in place among them, until the upgrade moves them; the rule is decided once per process per workspace.
portfolio_strategy_lab.unmoved_workspace.lower_layer: The rule reads the workspace's real lane files and asks the data root's log which lanes the door lacks.

product_host.a_reopened_goal_is_found_by.description: Reopening a goal answers it, a new one under a UUIDv7 and one opened under its old uuid5 once the upgrade step indexes it.
product_host.a_reopened_goal_is_found_by.lower_layer: The goal composition imports Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

product_host.backup_listing_read_creates.description: The live backup listing reads the held root and generations without adding a generation.
product_host.backup_listing_read_creates.lower_layer: The Storage route must read the same generations on its second call.

product_host.carried_result_with_changed.description: A copy's carried Portfolio result whose rows or profile differ from the result its digest names is refused by name when the Host opens the copy, before the catalog admits it.
product_host.carried_result_with_changed.lower_layer: The owner's rebuild reads the copy's real descriptors and the Host's opener holds a real data root; the unit layer cannot hold them.

product_host.copies_read_back_every_carr.description: A published Portfolio path's copy and restored backup read back every carried result and sealed Evidence snapshot ALL EQUAL on a new data root.
product_host.copies_read_back_every_carr.lower_layer: The proof uses a published Portfolio catalog, its Evidence log, backup and a second data root; the unit layer cannot hold them.

product_host.first_start_asks_a_clean_wo.description: A start asks the upgrade families once of a workspace folder holding no old data; its next start asks nothing, and another folder or a changed declaration is asked again.
product_host.first_start_asks_a_clean_wo.lower_layer: The proof starts the Host on a data root whose log records the answer; the unit layer's contract refuses its sqlite3.

product_host.first_start_asks_nothing_of.description: A fileless outcome chunk asks no upgrade only when the catalog holds its rows; one it lacks is refused by name; other faults stop the start.
product_host.first_start_asks_nothing_of.lower_layer: The upgrade family's module imports the Host's log, which the unit layer's contract refuses (sqlite3).

product_host.first_start_upgrades_every_.description: The first 0.2.8 start shows one plan for every old workspace, serves only the upgrade until acknowledged and done, resumes on that plan, and upgrades a later workspace at its open.
product_host.first_start_upgrades_every_.lower_layer: The proof is the Host composition itself: its socket, its log, the workspace leases and the backups; the unit layer cannot load them.

product_host.held_data_update_names_prov.description: A plan using held market data says that no provider work is needed.
product_host.held_data_update_names_prov.lower_layer: The maintenance owner imports Host facilities that the unit layer cannot load.

product_host.host_stop_keeps_finishing_v.description: A stopping Host retains its lease and read-only status while its active work finishes and leaves queued work for resumption.

product_host.panel_cleanup_keeps_current.description: A cleanup keeps the current Panel generation and the one before the last data update, and releases nothing while a Task is busy.
product_host.panel_cleanup_keeps_current.lower_layer: The generations are a real workspace's Panel files read under its writer session.

product_host.prepared_score_read_reuses_.description: A prepared score read takes the capture's world only at its formation while world is unmoved, equals the full reader's values, and is refused once the store changed.
product_host.prepared_score_read_reuses_.lower_layer: The proof reads a real workspace's store, Feature rows and world; the unit layer's contract refuses its database.

product_host.research_input_copies_liste.description: Each 0.2.7 binding copy is listed as the door keeps it, and a copy whose manifest names another binding is refused.
product_host.research_input_copies_liste.lower_layer: The listing reads a workspace's folders through the product host's bundle model, which a unit test may not import.

product_host.research_input_copies_remov.description: A workspace's 0.2.7 copies, held or a QA copy's, upgrade ALL EQUAL, read the same through a rollback, and are removed once their restored backup reads every binding equal.
product_host.research_input_copies_remov.lower_layer: The keep, the holds, the backup, its saved log and its restore are a real data root and log; only they show the replay.

product_host.research_input_copy_removal.description: A stop while the research input copies move aside or are deleted leaves every tree whole or retired, and the next step finishes the recorded set and both pools.
product_host.research_input_copy_removal.lower_layer: The removal runs the task upgrade's recorded set-aside on real folders after a real backup and replay on a real log; only those together show the resume.

product_host.research_input_copy_replay_.description: Copies of a workspace with no id on the log are refused before anything is kept, and a copy whose backed-up bytes replay unequal stops the upgrade and keeps every copy and pool.
product_host.research_input_copy_replay_.lower_layer: The keep, the backup and its saved log are a real data root and log; only they show the replay.

product_host.saved_object_probe_reads_ca.description: The saved-object probe, through its own entry, opens a published Portfolio path's copy by the product's opener and reads every carried result back ALL EQUAL to the publishing root.
product_host.saved_object_probe_reads_ca.lower_layer: The proof is the probe's own entry over a real Portfolio publication and two real data roots; the unit layer cannot hold them.

product_host.storage_cleanup_takes_only_.description: A storage cleanup takes only a person's confirmation of its eligible targets, never a research input, a forged target or a redirected path.
product_host.storage_cleanup_takes_only_.lower_layer: The plan, its journal and the unlinks are a real workspace's files under its writer session; only they show what a cleanup removes.

product_host.workspace_backup_restores_h.description: A workspace backup restores the held Tasks, every exported market table's rows and every held file's bytes.
product_host.workspace_backup_restores_h.lower_layer: The proof copies and restores real workspace files, a market database and a Task store.

research_authoring.schema_notes_end_on_a.description: If a schema's $ref chain were followed with no memory, a self-referencing definition would hang the client.

research_program.development_workspace_a.description: The workspace authority resolver reopens a bound research workspace with a stable authority and its full ordered session axis.
research_program.development_workspace_a.lower_layer: The real resolver reads the bound Panel, universe and source watermark on the development workspace.

research_program.factor_small_input_is_r.description: A Factor plan names the production listing floor and admits no Task when its bound input is too small.
research_program.factor_small_input_is_r.lower_layer: A real bound Panel and Host Task registry prove the input refusal precedes admission.

research_program.object_and_yaml_reject_.description: Both object and YAML declarations refuse an authored Python module path.
research_program.object_and_yaml_reject_.lower_layer: The tests exercise both declaration-loader entries directly.

research_program.unknown_universe_is_ref.description: The workspace authority resolver refuses an unknown universe handle by name.
research_program.unknown_universe_is_ref.lower_layer: The real resolver reads the workspace's bound research data when it checks authority.

resources.task_grants_obey_the_budget.description: A resource grant atomically debits the budget and returns exactly its reservation at release or observed process exit.

shared_kernel.a_wait_ends_at_its_bound.description: If a wait could run without a finite deadline, a hung check or a lost event would hold its caller for good.
shared_kernel.a_wait_ends_at_its_bound.retired: 2026-11-14: shared_kernel.waiting folded into shared_kernel.waits, one way to wait; shared_kernel.a_wait_ends_by_its_deadline_or_its_stop proves the same bound.

shared_kernel.a_wait_ends_by_its_deadlin.description: A wait returns its check's first result, or ends by name at its deadline or its stop event, and refuses an unbounded deadline.

shared_kernel.census_row_names_its_site_.description: If a census row named the wrong site or input, or raised on an input it cannot read, the census would rank work at the wrong file and line or stop the work it measures.

shared_kernel.child_processes_are_bounde.description: A child starts quietly with closed input and UTF-8 text, and a timeout ends its process tree.
shared_kernel.child_processes_are_bounde.lower_layer: The process and its descendant must actually run for the operating system to establish their lifetime and pipe behavior.

shared_kernel.schema_hash_ignores_prose_.description: If a schema hash followed docstrings or missed a structural change, a rewording would rotate every identity or a real change would keep one.

shared_kernel.work_census_tags_each_repe.description: If the work census tagged repeats wrongly, a repeat within one Task, a repeat by another Task, a verification at a process boundary and a write nothing reads would be ranked as the wrong lever.
shared_kernel.work_census_tags_each_repe.lower_layer: The tags are read from the rows each process writes to its own file, by DuckDB's JSON reader and window queries, so the proof needs a real file and a real query engine.

task_control.a_0_2_7_store_moves_in_admi.description: If Tasks admitted at one clock, or a 0.2.7 store from before admissions were ordered, lost their order on the log, the queue would start them out of turn.
task_control.a_0_2_7_store_moves_in_admi.lower_layer: The order is the registry's admission transaction and the import of a real DuckDB 0.2.7 store onto a real SQLite log.

task_control.a_duplicated_cancel_never_r.description: If a cancel sent again reached the Task version after the one its caller confirmed, a retry or a stale page could stop work nobody asked to stop.
task_control.a_duplicated_cancel_never_r.lower_layer: The cancel's version check and its one command are the registry's transaction on a real SQLite log.

task_control.a_killed_import_resumes_wit.description: If a kill between a 0.2.7 workspace's move onto the log and the retirement of its store lost or repeated a Task, its history would be wrong the next time it opened.
task_control.a_killed_import_resumes_wit.lower_layer: It reads real DuckDB, SQLite and JSONL sources, SDK spans and the durable log across reader retirement and reopening, which an in-memory function cannot prove.

task_control.a_lost_ledger_rebuilds_only.description: If recovery rebuilt the Task ledger from anything but frozen requests and orphan facts, a writer could invent, drop or repeat admitted Tasks.
task_control.a_lost_ledger_rebuilds_only.lower_layer: It reads real frozen request files and a real SQLite log across a reopened registry, which no single function holds.

task_control.a_recovery_execution_carrie.description: If a recovery execution took what the interrupted execution of its Task had carried in the process, its stages would skip verifying stored work that only the interrupted execution checked.

task_control.a_set_aside_set_stays_in_on.description: If a 0.2.7 database and its WAL were set aside into different directories when a move was interrupted, the kept copy would lose the database's committed writes.

task_control.a_wedged_worker_is_ended_by.description: If the Host waited on a worker that stopped running with no bound, a wedged call would hold its Task forever.

task_control.a_worker_ends_with_its_pare.description: If a kept worker watched its parent by polling, or not at all, a Host that died would leave workers running or end them late.

task_control.alpha_child_returns_parts_t.description: A real Alpha child returns each part to the Host, which keeps and reads it under its own log lock; a kept child reads the data root its caller names, not the one it was started under.
task_control.alpha_child_returns_parts_t.lower_layer: A real child and a held Host log are required to expose the cross-process writer conflict.

task_control.an_older_spelling_is_the_sa.description: If the import compared a 0.2.7 store's documents as text, a store spelled before a field was added would refuse to move onto the log, though its sealed states are equal.

task_control.dead_worker_reads_failed.description: A Task whose command raised and whose failure write died with it stops reading RUNNING at the Supervisor's next pass.

task_control.frozen_requests_refuse_cont.description: A frozen Task request must not be recovered from a file whose name does not bind its admitted content.

task_control.host_stop_preserves_recover.description: A Host stop finishes the current safe work, retains verified stages and resumes the same Task without treating the stop as a failed attempt.

testing.a_hot_loop_costs_at_most_two_per.description: If the kernel's owners plugged into a hot data loop cost more than 2%, the 0.2.9 kernel slows the data path it was meant to keep.
testing.a_hot_loop_costs_at_most_two_per.lower_layer: It times whole Panel-sized loops in pairs until the cost's margin is within 1%, in a serial run of its own, beyond a unit test's one second.

testing.a_merge_is_budgeted_against_the_.description: The commit hook measures a merge's test budget against the tip its committer names in ALPHALATTICE_TEST_BUDGET_BASE, so a merge onto a tip ahead of develop is not charged with the changes beneath it; unset, the base is develop.

testing.a_node_judges_its_operations_by_.description: A node judged by another machine's absolute budgets reads a slower or faster machine as a regression or a pass; an operation its record does not list is measured, not judged, and an unreadable record is refused by name.

testing.a_performance_judge_refuses_by_n.description: A performance judge that passes an operation over its budget, or a loop over its 2% bound, or rules before its 99% interval settles against the bound, lets a slowdown through or reads noise as one.

testing.a_test_is_killed_only_as_hung.description: A test is killed only as hung, at its size's hang guard (Bazel's small 60, medium 300, large 900 s); its speed is judged at admission, solo, never by a kill under load.

testing.a_test_leaking_its_interpreter_o.description: If a test changed sys.path or the working directory, or resolved a Host root outside its run, a later test or the person's data would pay for it.
testing.a_test_leaking_its_interpreter_o.lower_layer: The guards run in pytest's own setup and teardown hooks and wrap loaded modules, which the unit layer's audit refuses inside a test body.

testing.an_os_only_test_names_its_os.description: If a test a change writes reached a Windows-only API without naming its OS, it would fail on the macOS and Ubuntu runners; the commit refuses it with the repair.

testing.antipattern_rules_hold_the_produ.description: The nightly refuses new source anti-patterns and checks that every slow rule catches its planted case.
testing.antipattern_rules_hold_the_produ.lower_layer: The rules run as an external process against the tracked product tree and cannot be proved by a unit mock.

testing.codspeed_marks_every_selected_te.description: Under CodSpeed, which deselects unmarked tests, every selected test is marked as a benchmark so the public cost job measures each one; a run without CodSpeed marks none.
testing.codspeed_marks_every_selected_te.retired: 2026-11-14: CodSpeed was retired from the product (the person's decision); its cost job and checks were deleted with it.

testing.codspeed_slice_names_a_repeat_un.description: The cost job's pilot-slice check calls each test body twice over its fixtures, as CodSpeed does, and names a body that passes once and fails again, with its repair.
testing.codspeed_slice_names_a_repeat_un.lower_layer: The proof runs the workflow step's own code as a child pytest process over a planted slice, which a unit test cannot start.
testing.codspeed_slice_names_a_repeat_un.retired: 2026-11-14: CodSpeed was retired from the product (the person's decision); its cost job and checks were deleted with it.

testing.crash_requeue_keeps_longest_firs.description: Under load distribution, a crashed worker's prefetched cases return to their place in the longest-first collection order, never after every other case.

testing.each_kernel_operation_stays_with.description: A kernel operation whose mean call grows past its budget slows every owner that calls it, unseen until a release is measured.
testing.each_kernel_operation_stays_with.lower_layer: Its budget is a mean measured by pytest-benchmark in a serial run of its own, which a unit test under xdist cannot hold.

testing.fast_whole_tree_guard_runs_when_.description: A deferred whole-tree guard runs in the commit stage when the tree it declares it reads changed; one recorded as slow still waits for post-merge, and without the rule nothing moves.

testing.find_matches_requirements_and_un.description: One search returns the registered requirements and the unregistered tests whose words match, best first, with each requirement's lifecycle and holders.

testing.integration_share_only_falls.description: A change that raises an area's integration share of test functions is refused by name, and a row added above unit says why a lower layer cannot prove it.

testing.layer_contract.description: Registered unit layers obey resource and own-phase time boundaries, while integration layers retain their declared database and file access.

exception.decided: 2026-11-15: the excess is shared build-once fixtures and tool stubs that remove child processes; every case kept

testing.lint_rules_improve_the_code.description: Lint refuses a print outside the command layer and a public definition with no docstring, and accepts a bound lambda and a docstring's form.
testing.lint_rules_improve_the_code.lower_layer: The verdicts come from Ruff run as an external process with the product's own configuration and its per-path scopes, which a unit mock cannot prove.

exception.why: The source fell because a 141-line docstring checker became Ruff configuration, which the source count does not see; the goal asks one holder case per changed rule
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: the maintainer: one table-driven case holds the three rule verdicts

testing.narrow_fixture_scratch_goes_with.description: A fixture narrower than the session removes the temporary roots it made once its own teardown is done, unless a test failed while it lived; a session fixture keeps its roots to the session's end.

testing.observed_test_resources.description: Each completed test records its own phase durations and observed resources, including subprocess counts and explicit unknowns, without changing its result.

testing.one_holder_per_layer.description: A requirement has one holder file in each layer, while focused functions and parameter cases in that file preserve its place.

testing.only_a_requirement_marker_may_jo.description: If a requirement marker counted as file growth or a test change, tracing a critical test would be refused or push a Large test off its merge path.

testing.original_data_tests_stay_off_the.description: A test reaching a declared evidence root is refused unless a nightly_only or release_only Large rule names an upgrade or restore replay as its reason to keep original data.
testing.original_data_tests_stay_off_the.lower_layer: The guard reads the whole tests tree, the evidence-root declarations and the size registry as committed, which a unit fixture cannot stand in for.

testing.paid_agent_runs_only_on_request.description: A test marked paid_agent, which spends money on a model turn, is deselected by every run unless that run sets ALPHALATTICE_PAID_AGENT_RUN=1.

testing.private_support_import_requires_.description: Directly importing the evaluator's test support requires both an isolated data root and an isolated backup root, even when its runner was never started.

testing.reuse_pin_fast_check.description: The fast lane runs the reviewed reuse frontier check on changed pinned source files and names how to refresh a moved pin.

testing.row_admitted_or_refused_by_its_c.description: A new or edited requirement row is admitted at once when its id, owner, sentence, layer and budget pass without a near-duplicate, and is otherwise refused by its failing check or held for the test manager's decision.

testing.session_footprint.description: A verified full pytest run records session-fixture build time and attributed scratch with a sampled basetemp high-water mark and explicit gaps.

testing.size_counts_are_review_signals.description: A size or form count over its bound (C901, PLR0912, PLR0915, more than four mocks) never refuses a commit and is named as a signal in a function the change wrote; a blanket type ignore still refuses.
testing.size_counts_are_review_signals.lower_layer: The counts come from Ruff run as an external process over the change's text, which a unit mock cannot prove.

testing.test_budgets_only_fall.description: A raised or added test budget is refused at commit unless a budget admission carries a dated decision and a value at or above it.

testing.test_placement_and_structural_sc.description: New test files must declare their owner and source, and a deferred structural test must have a valid scope before selection.
testing.test_placement_and_structural_sc.lower_layer: The selection checks read and construct registered policy files, which a unit test cannot access.

testing.tests_grow_no_faster_than_source.description: A change whose net test lines outgrow its net source past the policy's floor is refused by name, unless each new test's requirement carries the test manager's decided growth exception.

exception.why: The rule's own test gains the planted case of a rewrite that adds no test function
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: fix the rule with one planted case in the existing growth test

testing.the_semgrep_scan_gets_a_short_te.description: If semgrep ran under a stage's long TEMP on Windows, semgrep-core would fail on the path limit and the source rules would refuse every change unmeasured.

testing.the_stage_judges_the_committed_c.description: If the commit stage judged only the working tree, a committed test-shape break the hook refuses at the index would pass the stage, or an inherited one would refuse it.
testing.the_stage_judges_the_committed_c.lower_layer: The check chooses its snapshot through Git processes, the merge base and the head or index blobs, and the unit layer may not depend on subprocess.

testing.unplaced_workers_warn_by_name.description: Inside the private workshop, an unplaced pytest run asking for more than two workers is warned once with heavy_slot's command, never refused; other runs stay silent.

testing.unregistered_test_refused_with_i.description: A new test that proves no registered requirement is refused by the fast guard with what tests find returns for its words and the next lawful step, and in a gate lane beyond its file's legacy count.

testing.whole_file_relocation_restores_b.description: Whole-file test relocation restores bytes and registered references, preserves consumed fixture scope and refuses path, export and fixture-name clashes.
testing.whole_file_relocation_restores_b.retired: 2026-11-08: the completed one-time test mover was retired; placement and structural scope checks stay.

testing.windows_worker_without_wmi.description: A Windows pytest worker obtains platform information without issuing a WMI query.

testing.worker_collection_refusal_is_nam.description: An xdist worker that refuses its collection names itself and the refusal in the run's log before it ends, so a stage never reports only a crash on a test that never ran.

testing.worker_crash_evidence_is_named.description: A dead pytest worker records its actual exit, running test and fault output, and missing evidence remains unknown.

workspace_runtime.a_derived_view_answers.description: A declared derived view answers in its workspace table's place only under its setting, and is refused by name without a setup.
workspace_runtime.a_derived_view_answers.retired: 2026-11-20: the opt-in derived Feature view is retired

workspace_runtime.a_failed_build_is_neve.description: If a request value whose builder failed were kept, every later read would answer from that refusal instead of building again.
workspace_runtime.a_failed_build_is_neve.lower_layer: It reads through the process-wide request cache every test in the process shares, which a unit test may not reach.

workspace_runtime.a_held_file_is_release.description: A held workspace database keeps one instance between its connections and closes it before another instance attaches the file, during another process's call, for a writer, and at the hold's end.
workspace_runtime.a_held_file_is_release.lower_layer: The proof is the engine's own refusal to attach a file another instance of the process holds, which only a real database file shows.

workspace_runtime.a_kept_value_follows_i.description: If a value kept for a sealed file answered after that file was gone or replaced at its path, a replay would prove an artifact the workspace no longer holds.
workspace_runtime.a_kept_value_follows_i.lower_layer: It removes and rewrites a real sealed file behind the store's process memory, which only the file system holds.

exception.why: The memo's 20 existing tests state both file-system rules (kept, and not kept where no lifetime handle exists) instead of skipping there, as the review required
exception.decided: 2026-11-15: the excess is the coverage of the second file-system rule; keep every check

workspace_runtime.an_interrupt_ends_a_so.description: If waiting on parallel source checks swallowed an interrupt, Ctrl-C could not stop a verification.

exception.why: The goal's Proof requires one unit test per bounded runtime loop; net source is negative because the card deletes the uncalled PreFactorWorkspaceHost.run.
exception.decided: 2026-11-16: granted: one unit test per bounded loop is the goal's proof, each one function under 30 lines with no fixture world; source falls because dead code is deleted, which the growth rule never weighs against new proof

workspace_runtime.an_unvouched_mutable_v.description: If the process cache kept a mutable value no caller vouched for, one reader could change what the next reader is given.
workspace_runtime.an_unvouched_mutable_v.lower_layer: It reads through the process-wide request cache every test in the process shares, which a unit test may not reach.

workspace_runtime.background_task_gate_w.description: A background Task waits for a workspace mutation holder, names the holder and preserves its deferred cancellation without duplicating execution.

workspace_runtime.changed_file_ends_its_.description: If a file's kept digest survived a change to its bytes, a later read would trust content it never hashed.
workspace_runtime.changed_file_ends_its_.lower_layer: The fact journal is keyed by the file's bytes and stamps on disk, which only a filesystem test can change.

workspace_runtime.feature_panel_chunk_re.description: A Panel chunk address that names another content hash is refused, so a descriptor can never resolve another chunk's bytes under its own identity.
A descriptor of another artifact kind resolves as no feature panel chunk, so a feature input's file is never served as a Panel chunk.
A published Panel chunk resolves by its descriptor to the Parquet file stored under its content hash, so the Panel reader finds the bytes it was written with.

workspace_runtime.full_proof_refuses_a_c.description: If full proof trusted a sealed file's name or stamps, an export or the scrub would pass bytes changed under that name.
workspace_runtime.full_proof_refuses_a_c.lower_layer: The change is planted in a real file under its sealed name with its stamps restored, which only a filesystem test can do.

workspace_runtime.host_stop_reaches_para.description: A Host stop reaches each concurrent work-item thread and leaves the admitted Task recoverable after its workers return.

workspace_runtime.installed_extensions_o.description: Every workspace handle refuses SQL and method forms of runtime extension installation before the engine can read a repository.
workspace_runtime.installed_extensions_o.lower_layer: The native DuckDB statement parser and registration APIs define this boundary; an in-memory policy double cannot prove that SQL and method calls reach it.

workspace_runtime.panel_bodies_follow_th.description: Each Panel lifecycle publication roots the available snapshots' chunks, collects other bodies, and evicts unread bodies only while their stored chunk proves its content.
workspace_runtime.panel_bodies_follow_th.lower_layer: Roots, eviction and collection run through the Host's StorePort and its log, which the unit layer cannot open.
workspace_runtime.panel_bodies_follow_th.retired: 2026-11-20: the opt-in derived Panel bodies are retired; the stored chunk is the one reader

workspace_runtime.panel_chunks_read_from.description: Under derived reads the Host keeps each Panel chunk once, byte for byte, and reads take that body; stored reads the workspace's file.
workspace_runtime.panel_chunks_read_from.lower_layer: The body is kept through the Host's StorePort and its log, which the unit layer cannot open.
workspace_runtime.panel_chunks_read_from.retired: 2026-11-20: the opt-in derived Panel bodies are retired; the stored chunk is the one reader

workspace_runtime.panel_preprocessing_ma.description: A Panel keeps its sealed preprocessing marker when the incoming method matches or follows recorded fingerprint successors, and refuses other method or policy changes.

workspace_runtime.panel_reads_key_a_chun.description: A derived Panel keep is keyed by the chunk's recorded binding, year and part; stored keeps nothing; unknown or unserved settings are refused.
workspace_runtime.panel_reads_key_a_chun.retired: 2026-11-20: the opt-in derived Panel bodies are retired

workspace_runtime.panel_roots_are_the_av.description: Under derived reads a Panel lifecycle publication hands the Host every available snapshot's chunks and the Panel reader's proof of each chunk's stored source.
workspace_runtime.panel_roots_are_the_av.retired: 2026-11-20: the opt-in derived Panel bodies are retired

workspace_runtime.parallel_source_checks.description: If parallel source checks shared contexts, ran unbounded or lost a failure, a check could leak another's memory, starve the process or pass a refusal.
workspace_runtime.parallel_source_checks.lower_layer: It drives the shared check pool from several threads at once, which a unit test of one callback cannot exercise.

workspace_runtime.seal_record_survives_a.description: A file another process holds neither stops a store's open while the hold is brief nor kills a worker at its close.

workspace_runtime.sealed_read_leaves_not.description: If reading sealed bytes left a watching thread or an open handle, the Host would spend CPU on every read and a file could not be renamed or removed.
workspace_runtime.sealed_read_leaves_not.lower_layer: Open handles and live threads are process facts a unit test cannot observe without the real store and filesystem.

workspace_runtime.sealed_reads_share_one.description: If concurrent readers of one sealed source each built it, or a failed build were kept, the Host would repeat the work or answer from a refusal.
workspace_runtime.sealed_reads_share_one.lower_layer: It runs real threads against the process memory's single producer, which a unit test of one call cannot interleave.

workspace_runtime.sealed_value_built_onc.description: If a value built from sealed sources were built again on every read, each read would pay a proof the Host's only-writer rule already settled; full proof must still build it from the bytes.
workspace_runtime.sealed_value_built_onc.lower_layer: It reads real sealed files through the store's process memory across request scopes, which a unit test of one function cannot hold.

workspace_runtime.source_lease_failure_e.description: A failed sealed-source mutation check names the written and observed bytes, restored and observed metadata, and the unavailable lease event.
workspace_runtime.source_lease_failure_e.retired: 2026-11-15: read leases retired; a sealed file is proved at its edges (LAWS.md EV2)

workspace_runtime.source_owner_keeps_one.description: If an owner's complete value kept a second copy of its nested bytes, or kept a mutable result, memory would double or one caller could change another's read.
workspace_runtime.source_owner_keeps_one.lower_layer: It counts decodes and reads across nested owners on real files through the process memory, beyond one function's reach.
